\section{Computational Information Value and Reusable Summaries}
\PROVED\ (exact generalized-support frontier; linear persisted summaries).
Let a fixed parity batch have row code \(C\le\mathbb F_2^b\) of dimension
\(r\), and let \(d_k(C)\) be its \(k\)-th generalized Hamming weight.  If
preprocessing persists at most \(L\) linear source bits while continuation
retains the original source and may adaptively probe raw coordinates, then
\[
 Q^*_{\rm lin}(L)=d_{r-L}(C).
\]
At each reachable leaf, exactness gives \(C\subseteq S+E_J\), so
\(C\cap E_J\) contains an \((r-L)\)-dimensional subcode supported on the
queried coordinates.  Conversely, store a complement of an attaining
subcode and read its support.  The theorem permits stored linear forms
outside \(C\) and adaptive continuation, but not arbitrary nonlinear
summary fibers.

\FALSIFIED\ (compact representation implies cheap construction).
At \(L=r-1\), the optimum is \(d_1(C)\), the minimum distance of \(C\).
Computing this value for general binary linear codes is NP-hard.  A supplied
attaining subcode is polynomially verifiable and executable, but finding it
is a separate \(P_{\rm discover}\) obligation.  In the finite nonlinear
control through \(b=4\), 1,672,200 one-bit summaries produced no advantage
over the linear frontier; this is \COMPUTATIONAL\ evidence only.  The
arbitrary-nonlinear frontier, strict22 authentication, and native tape/UTM
transport remain \OPEN.  Source:
\path{research/main/2026-10-29_2048_MAIN_GENERALIZED-SUPPORT-FRONTIER-REFEREE212.tex}.

\PROVED\ (batch answer-vector transcript bound; indexed binary-source model).
For a fixed batch of future contexts let \(R\) be the number of distinct exact
batch answer vectors induced by the source family.  If preprocessing uses at
most \(P_{\rm src}\) binary source probes and leaves at most \(L\)
source-dependent persisted bits, while the continuation uses at most
\(Q_{\rm src}\) binary source probes across the entire batch with arbitrary
adaptive caching and recomputation, then
\[
 2^{\min(P_{\rm src},L)+Q_{\rm src}}\ge R.
\]
All source-dependent side channels must be charged in the persisted state.
For a linear parity batch \(Wa\) this gives
\(\min(P_{\rm src},L)+Q_{\rm src}\ge\rank W\); coordinate batches attain
every point \(P_{\rm src}=L,\ Q_{\rm src}=\rank W-L\).
Thus multiplying a one-query probe lower bound by the number of contexts is
\FALSIFIED\ when retained-source access and persistent caching are allowed:
all \(b\) source bits can be read once and reused for any polynomial parity
batch.  Query input, output, arithmetic, verification and peak storage remain
charged.  This is not a SAT lower bound.

\PROVED\ (affine contextual rank potential).
For current certified source set \(a_0+U\) and target batch \(W\), the
independently computable potential \(\Phi_W=\dim W(U)\) drops by exactly zero
or one under one consistent certified linear fact.  Duplicates have value
zero; XOR shares exhibit complementarity, so initial singleton values are not
additive.  Acquisition, verification and application cost are separate from
\(I\mid_{v_{\Phi_W}}\).  Exact generalized-support refinement for rank
\(r<b\), authenticated SAT-context transport, nonlinear potentials, and
machine-model conversion remain \OPEN.  Source:
\path{research/main/2026-10-29_1948_MAIN_BATCH-RANK-AMORTIZATION-REFEREE211.tex}.

\PROVED\ (exact finite interaction model; restricted application).
For a declared state, known certified facts, target, cost model and independently
defined potential, write \(I\mid_v\) with
\(v_\Phi(I\mid s,K)=\Phi(s,K)-\Phi(s,K\cup\{I\})\).
For a finite fact menu \(E\), the gain set function
\(g(S)=\Phi(s,K)-\Phi(s,K\cup S)\) has the unique interaction dividends
\[
 d(U)=\sum_{V\subseteq U}(-1)^{|U|-|V|}g(V),\qquad
 g(S)=\sum_{U\subseteq S}d(U).
\]
The marginal of fact \(I\) after \(S\) is the sum of precisely those dividends
containing \(I\) and contained in \(S\cup\{I\}\).  Positive higher-order
terms capture complementarity; negative terms capture redundancy.  Actual
marginals telescope along a certified execution, but initial singleton labels
are not additive.  An arbitrary normalized Boolean ledger on \(m\) facts has
\(2^m-1\) independent bits; fixed certified interaction order \(k\) leaves only
\(\sum_{j\le k}\binom mj=O(m^k)\) coefficients, whose discovery and bit lengths
must still be charged.

\PROVED\ (detached reusable-summary and retained-source quantifier firewall).
For source family \(\mathcal A\), future contexts \(\mathcal B\), and answer
vectors \(r_A=(D(A,B))_{B\in\mathcal B}\), any deterministic fixed-length
detached summary exact for all later contexts satisfies
\(L\ge\lceil\log_2|\{r_A\}|\rceil\).  For all pin contexts these vectors are
the boundary functions \(f_A(x)=\exists y\,A(x,y)\).  Report228 realizes
every \(b\)-bit boundary function by a canonical proper 3CNF
\(A_f\) of \(N_b=\Theta(b^2 2^b)\) bits, so a source-discarding summary
prepared before the pin and exact for all pins needs at least \(2^b\) bits.

\PROVED\ (same-family targeted-source escape, restricted promise).
After a canonical point continuation \(B_a\) reveals \(a\), a fixed
source-retaining controller reads the first literal word of block \(a\):
a boundary-variable identifier means \(f(a)=0\), while a private identifier
means \(f(a)=1\).  Thus one source-word probe and \(O(b)\) address/work
bits decide \(\operatorname{SAT}(A_f\wedge B_a)\).  On the native indexed
bit model the word's \(\Theta(b)\) bits and address arithmetic are charged;
recognizing an unpromised source costs a scan and nonmembers require exact
fallback.  Hence the detached all-query floor does not lower-bound a joint or
source-retaining solver, and a realized run is not charged for all
counterfactual pins.  This easy-family accessor is not an all-input ARC
successor.  Since at most \(2^{N+1}-1\) source descriptions have length at
most \(N\), storing the original source remains a legal control and counting
alone cannot force exponential summary length relative to \(N\).  Source:
\path{research/main/2026-10-30_1748_MAIN_ARC-SOURCE-RETENTION-QUANTIFIER-FIREWALL229.tex}.

\FALSIFIED\ (unrestricted value policy).
Duplicate facts and two XOR shares respectively require negative redundancy and
positive synergy terms.  A policy that selects only a strictly positive current
singleton value can pay an arbitrarily costly direct-answer action while two
initially zero-valued XOR shares solve the target cheaply.  Value acquisition,
authentication, verification, application and score computation remain separate
charged costs.  These are policy and accounting theorems, not SAT lower bounds.
Source:
\path{research/main/2026-10-29_1848_MAIN_CONTEXTUAL-VALUE-DIVIDEND-REFEREE210.tex}.

\section{Known Unconditional Lower Bounds}
The strongest unconditional circuit lower bounds for explicit functions remain modest relative to the thresholds needed to separate P from NP.

\begin{itemize}
\item For general Boolean circuits over the $B_2$ basis, the best known lower bound for an explicit function in P is $3.5n - O(\log n)$ (Mishra--Santhanam, ECCC TR26-260, October 2026).
\end{itemize}

\section{Time-Space Tradeoffs}
\KNOWN\ (Fortnow--Lipton--van Melkebeek--Viglas, Williams).  
In the indexed read-only-input random-access model, SAT cannot be decided simultaneously in time $N^{t+o(1)}$ and space $N^{s+o(1)}$ whenever
\[
s < \beta(t) := \frac12\Bigl(\frac{t+2}{t^2}-t\Bigr)
\]
for the applicable range of $t$, and in particular cannot be decided in time $N^{2\cos(\pi/7)-o(1)}$ and space $N^{o(1)}$ (Williams). These are the strongest published simultaneous bounds used in the present investigation. Numerical evaluation confirms $2\cos(\pi/7)\approx 1.801938$. Buss--Williams established that this endpoint is optimal within the framework of alternation-trading proofs for the subpolynomial-space case.

\section{Constructive Single-Child Route and Oracle Firewall}
\PROVED\ (elementary sufficient theorem, peer review pending).
Let $\mathcal C$ be a closed encoded class containing an NP-complete language.
If one fixed deterministic total uniform algorithm physically produces, on
every valid nonbase $x\in\mathcal C$, one answer-preserving child
$G(x)\in\mathcal C$ with $|G(x)|\le |x|^\lambda$ for fixed
$0<\lambda<1$, and all construction/access cost is $O(|x|^c)$, then
\[
 T(N)\le N^c+T(N^\lambda)=O(N^c).
\]
Fixed bounded bases therefore give SAT in P.  Bare existence of such a map is
a reformulation rather than progress: if SAT were already in P, a decider
could output one of two fixed YES/NO bases.

\FALSIFIED\ (theorem transfer).
At OpenAI \texttt{math} commit
\texttt{adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a}, the unitary-synthesis
preprint proves a uniformly generated polynomial quantum skeleton with one
smaller quantum call per level, but the target chooses unrestricted Boolean
oracle contents.  The source explicitly gives no efficient classical
constructor for those contents and states that the generator never computes a
table entry.  The quantifiers $\forall x\,\exists f_x$ alone give no
classical upper bound: a one-query skeleton can use the hindsight bit
$f_x(0)=L(x)$ for any language $L$.  A valid classical repair needs one fixed
polynomial evaluator $E(x,q)=f_x(q)$, or a uniformly materialized and charged
oracle circuit; then ordinary composition is polynomial.

\PROVED\ (restricted representation audit, peer review pending).
For
\[
 F_t(z)=\bigwedge_i(z\vee A_i)\wedge
        \bigwedge_j(\neg z\vee B_j),
\qquad
 \exists z\,F_t=
 (\bigwedge_iA_i)\vee(\bigwedge_jB_j)
 =\bigwedge_{i,j}(A_i\vee B_j),
\]
with disjoint two-literal $A_i,B_j$, the auxiliary-free projection has
$t^2$ prime-implicate clauses, while a shared fan-in-two circuit has $4t-1$
gates.  Full Tseitin re-entry has $12t-2$ clauses and remains
$\Theta(t\log t)$ bits, the same exponent as the original selector.
Reintroducing one selector can reproduce the original encoded instance exactly.
Thus compact representation is useful but supplies no fixed-power, recursively
closed shrink on this family.  Exhaustive checks covered 69,904 assignments;
finite evidence remains \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL}.

\PROVED\ (restricted decision--context separation; independently refereed).
For the connected proper 3CNF family $F_{t,s}$ in report202, every
unaugmented source is SAT and therefore has one decision state and a constant
YES child on its recognizable promise class.  Yet four-pin continuations
$Q_i$ satisfy $\operatorname{SAT}(F_{t,s}\land Q_i)=s_i$, so any source-free
state supporting an adversarially selected continuation has $2^t$ values and
at least $t$ bits on some source.  This exact INDEX floor is for the richer
online query contract; it is \FALSIFIED\ as a lower bound on decision-only
contraction.  The promise class does not contain arbitrary SAT.

\OPEN.  The decisive constructive arrow is an unconditional, answer-oblivious,
all-input child constructor with physical encoded shrink, effective choices,
closure at a second genuine recursive level, and charged failed attempts,
storage, access, and model transport.  A local failure or a restricted
representation lower bound does not imply P$\ne$NP.

\section{Conditional Resource Contraction}
Under the temporary assumption that a fixed uniform deterministic total correct SAT solver $A$ exists with
\[
T_A(N)\le N^{K+o(1)},\qquad S_A(N)\le N^{L+o(1)}
\]
for unknown finite $K,L\ge 2$, the parameters $\lambda=1/(5K)$, $\zeta=0.1$ would, if an all-input transformation of the stated budget existed, yield a simultaneous profile
\[

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-MONOTONE-FOUR-CORE287 (31 October 2026, 18:00 PDT): complete four-clause monotone residual classification and unit-propagation dominance.}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT bounded theorem using known Tarsi deficiency; COMPUTATIONAL independently verified; arbitrary-$A$ hereditary ARC, quantitative ordinary-SAT FLMV transport and P versus NP OPEN.}
Every inclusion-minimal unsatisfiable monotone residual subformula of exactly four clauses with width at most three is, up to source-variable renaming and simultaneous polarity reversal, one of exactly three templates:
$(x),(y),(z),(\neg x\lor\neg y\lor\neg z)$;
$(x),(y\lor z),(\neg x\lor\neg y),(\neg x\lor\neg z)$; or
$(x),(\neg y),(y\lor z),(\neg x\lor\neg z)$.
Tarsi's established minimally-unsatisfiable deficiency bound reduces every four-clause core to at most three variables. Exhaustive exact verification of all $\binom{14}{4}=1001$ four-subsets of the 14 possible signed monotone clauses over three variables finds precisely 14 minimal cores, arranged in symmetry classes $2,6,6$. Each template is refuted by unit propagation. Thus an added four-core scanner contributes \emph{no additional sound deduction} beyond already charged UP. More strongly, every monotone width-at-most-three CNF with at most five clauses is decided by UP: after reaching a unit-free fixed point, Tarsi reduces any hypothetical minimal UNSAT core to at most four variables; all $\binom{20}{5}=15504$ five-subsets of the 20 signed monotone width-two/three clauses on four variables are SAT. The six-clause odd-cycle NAE triangle is a sharp unit-free UNSAT countercontrol but is not itself the canonical original input language.
A valid source $K33$ with $n=9,m=12$ has 18 exact SAT models and a coherent restriction $x_2=0,x_3=1,x_4=0,x_7=0,x_8=1,x_9=1$ leaving exactly the original-indexed clauses $C_1,C_3,C_6,C_7$ as the minimal UNSAT four-core $(x_5\lor x_6),(x_1),(\neg x_1\lor\neg x_5),(\neg x_1\lor\neg x_6)$; all three-subsets are SAT. Four ordinary original-source resolution steps derive the valid learned clause $\boxed{x_4\lor x_7\lor\neg x_8\lor\neg x_9}$, excluding the larger original four-coordinate cube. Source-indexed original S/U, SS/SU/US/UU, coherent $0^n/1^n$ and intermediate flip, binary/Gray logical XOR and adverse U198-UNSAT/V198-SAT controls are in the complete raw archive. The independent no-producer-import verifier passed 872991 assertions, including 64 source-certified U198 boundary rows, 152 module DPLL calls, complete V198 SAT witness checking, all 230300 four-subsets over five variables, and the 15504 unit-free five-subsets. The new full-trace recharge lemma counts actual physical index \emph{one-bit} creations $P$, bulk-erased one-bits $E$, and opening index population $\Phi_a$, obtaining $E_{a,b}\le\Phi_a+P_{a,b}$ and, for any chronological checkpoint partition, $X_{a,b}\le2q(b-a)+\Phi_a$. Hence every complete initially blank-index run satisfies $T\ge X/(2q)$, with a machine-specific constant $q$ of ordinary changed physical bit cells per native step. A single index reset may still erase $h$ bits in one step; the coefficient $2$ is asymptotically sharp for one local write port by $h$ charged writes and one reset. Head-address encodings and lazy logical clause states are not counted as physical writes; arbitrary SAT runtime lower bounds do not follow.
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL.} A separately written verifier passed 963,201 assertions on 478,499 toy-machine states and original source-indexed SAT/UNSAT controls. \paragraph{LSPV-1 H22-DANGEROUS-HITSET282: two-edge dangerous-clause transversal for source-authenticated matching SAT terminals (31 October 2026, 13:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted via Edmonds, external mathematical review pending; COMPUTATIONAL independently checked same-source YES/NO; OPEN hereditary target ARC, matched FLMV transfer and P versus NP.}
For every valid duplicate-free proper monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) source, the positive original-clause dual is a labelled cubic multigraph. Let $q$ count negative original clauses whose three positive edges are pairwise disjoint, and $\tau$ be the minimum number of original variable-edge labels intersecting all those dangerous clauses. A positive-perfect-matching witness is source SAT if and only if no dangerous triple lies wholly in the matching, equivalently if some choice of one forbidden label per dangerous clause leaves a perfect matching (at most $3^q$ calls). If the positive dual is bridgeless and $\tau\le2$, Edmonds' uniform one-third edge-marginal polytope guarantees a matching avoiding the hitting labels, so a deterministic polynomial source-verified SAT terminal exists. The symmetric negative-dual theorem also holds. The exact signed quota gives $q\le2\tau$, and the bound is attained by a new valid connected nonbipartite $12$-variable example with $q=4$, $\tau=2$, chosen hitset $\{1,8\}$, safe matching $\{2,6,9,12\}$, and $228$ fully enumerated SAT models. A different valid nine-variable source has $18$ SAT models despite \emph{no} safe positive matching, so failure of the terminal is never an UNSAT certificate.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 MONOTONE-QUOTA-CUBE281: signed partial-cube quota subsumption and formula-independent first-shell signatures (31 October 2026, 12:26 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT elementary restricted; independent mathematical review pending;
COMPUTATIONAL independent both-label audit; OPEN hereditary target ARC, FLMV transport, and P versus NP.}
For each valid proper duplicate-free monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) source with $n$ original names and each coherent partial cube assigning $t$ TRUE and $f$ FALSE, let $q_{r,-}$ and $q_{r,+}$ count original negative/positive clauses with exactly $r$ source literals not already fixed FALSE.
Exact two-per-sign occurrence accounting gives
\[
q_{0,-}=2(t-2n/3)+q_{2,-}+2q_{3,-},\qquad
q_{0,+}=2(f-2n/3)+q_{2,+}+2q_{3,+}.
\]
Here each $q_0$ counts \emph{original falsified clause IDs}. Hence exceeding $t>2n/3$ or $f>2n/3$ already falsifies source clauses and cannot reject any additional partial cube beyond complete original-clause checking; the converse fails by pinning just one three-variable clause false.
Every canonical source has original truth-count four-bucket signature $(2n/3,0,0,2n/3)$ at both coherent endpoints and $(2n/3-2,2,2,2n/3-2)$ after any single original-variable flip from either endpoint. Thus \emph{coarse first-shell histograms alone} cannot classify the SAT label, without making claims about source-indexed algorithms.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 MONOTONE-PORT-CUT280: two-port congruence and a source-faithful separator obstruction (31 October 2026, 11:58 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent mathematical referee pending; COMPUTATIONAL full original-source both-label audit; OPEN hereditary canonical-target ARC, FLMV transfer, and P versus NP.}
The revised target is every valid instance of the NP-complete proper duplicate-free clausewise-monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) language, with malformed encodings rejected. For a connected canonical source, boundary \(B\) of \(b\ge1\) original names, \(h\) all-boundary clauses, and \(k\) nonempty private primal components, count original positive and negative boundary ports \(e_i^+,e_i^-\) into component \(i\). Exact signed occurrence quotas yield
\[
3m_i^+=2|P_i|+e_i^+,\qquad
3m_i^-=2|P_i|+e_i^-,\qquad
e_i^+\equiv e_i^-\pmod3.
\]
Each connected nonempty component consumes at least two boundary ports, so
\(2k\le 4b-3h\), in particular \(k\le2b\).
At most \(4b\) original clauses touch \(B\). Hence for every coherent boundary assignment a component retains at least \(2n/(3b)-2\) \emph{unchanged original clauses}. On an explicit \(N=\Theta(n\log n)\)-bit original-source representation any \emph{source-clause-retaining} child has size \(\Omega(N/(b\log N))\); a logarithmic boundary cannot yield \(N^{1/2+o(1)}\) children on all connected target inputs by this raw ordered-separator emitter. This \emph{does not exclude semantic compression, certified terminal policies, arbitrary algorithms, or prove an unconditional time bound}. An explicit infinite \emph{canonical} family attains \(k=2b\) with \(n=9b,m=12b\), but is readily SAT and therefore is not a hardness witness. The previously verified mixed-sign \(k=3b+1\) constructions remain valid outside the sign-monochromatic theorem.

A dependency-free original-source audit checked five sharp sizes (\(b=1,2,3,4,7\)), 1245 alternate cuts, all original S/U-inverse and SS/SU/US/UU modes, signed-resolution forbidden cubes, eight malformed controls and independent complete SAT/UNSAT target labels. \paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-QUERY-SPECTRUM275: adaptive heterogeneous DELAY query-cost identity (31 October 2026, 09:35 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted; independent mathematical review pending;}
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL} finite original-source SAT/UNSAT controls;
the arbitrary-decider ARC edge and $P$ versus $NP$ remain \OPEN.
For a boolean-answer-driven, code-opaque residual-SAT controller executing a completed sequence of ordinary-SAT queries of lengths $M_i$, all query transcripts are unchanged by a correct $M^D$ DELAY wrapper.
Let $q_b$ count calls in size band $2^b\le M_i<2^{b+1}$ and $B=\lfloor\log_2\max_i M_i\rfloor$.
The fully charged delay-only guest workload has the exact band bounds
\[
\max_b q_b2^{Db}\;\le\; W_D=\sum_i(M_i+1)^D\;
\le\;2^D(B+1)\max_bq_b2^{Db}.
\]
For polynomial query lengths, this yields the sharp exponent of the sequential guest workload up to $o_D(1)$.
It falsifies an opaque ARC architecture that compulsorily calls an arbitrary guest on any $N^{1/2+\epsilon}$ query on infinitely many sources, or on $N^{3/5+\epsilon}$ near-$N^{1/2}$ queries; it does \emph{not} exclude a code-aware compiler that bypasses such calls.
Physical materialization of $N^{3/5}$ children each of length $N^{1/2}$ already costs $N^{11/10}$ writes, saturating the candidate parent-stage exponent.
An independently implemented finite verifier passed 723 checks and rejected three injected corruptions on one seven-of-eight signed-ternary SAT source and its eight-of-eight UNSAT counterpart; 16 separately parsed ordinary Shannon children preserve both labels.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-BOUNDARY-ZERO-COVER273: exact adaptive two-sided source-query transcripts (31 October 2026, 07:24 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted; independent review pending.}

$s_a,t_a$ ($a<q=2^k$), the source is SAT exactly when
$\bigvee_{a<q}(s_a\wedge t_a)$ holds.
Any partial adaptive source-bit query transcript is a \emph{universally
valid SAT certificate} precisely when it has observed

pin at every index. The converses use explicit opposite-label
completions of unqueried source bits. Thus every negative transcript
needs at least $q$ informative indexed reads, whereas a sequential
source-aware exact algorithm uses at most $2q$ pin reads and
$O(k)$ scratch \emph{after charged grammar authentication}.
This is a restricted instance of known decision-tree certificate
principles, \emph{not} an unrestricted SAT query or space lower bound.
The predecessor MAIN228 already established a related one-way reusable
summary floor; the new lemma emphasizes two-sided exact decision
transcripts and the source-rereading escape.

$K_*=\max\{\alpha,\gamma/(1-\lambda)\}<1/\lambda$ and
$\alpha<1+\gamma$, an architecture that at \emph{every} successor
level has worst-case sources producing $\Omega(N^\gamma)$ guest-child
attempts, each \emph{really} rereading $\Omega(N)$ original-input bits,
is incompatible with the recurrence.  Physical source reads alone require
$\Omega(N^{1+\gamma})$ time, but iterating the recurrence from any unknown
finite initial $K$ yields a successor upper exponent strictly below
$1+\gamma$.  For $(\alpha,\gamma,\lambda)=(11/10,3/5,1/2)$
the cold read floor is $8/5$, while the conditional fixed point is $6/5$;
once parent $K<2$ the asserted child successor exponent is $<8/5$.
This falsifies the repeatedly \emph{cold-scanning} compiler architecture,
not arbitrary SAT algorithms.  Source-aware recognition, cached one-pass
sharing, reduced child multiplicity, changed policies, checked terminals
and other paid access designs explicitly escape the hypothesis.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL.} An independently implemented Python checker
passed 2,618 assertions over 12 original CNFs (7 SAT, 5 UNSAT):
185 indexed signed occurrences, 732 source-clause SS/SU/US/UU
modes, 76 original-resolution prohibited cubes and 48 physically
serialized and reparsed ordinary children with correct both-label
cofactor joins, source endpoints, inversion and flip trails.
Standard UP-DPLL explored 51 nodes and 878 selected events; the
cold-scan guest-controller explored 53 guest nodes and 6,866
nonstandard selected events, including 2,832 executed original
character reads, 894 child output characters and 740 cofactor
literal visits.  These differing host-event profiles are
\emph{not} FLMV tape-step or simultaneous-space upper bounds;
the audit intentionally retains all child transcripts.
An exact rational recurrence checker covers initial exponents
$K_0=2,4,8,16,32,100$ and strict collisions after parent
levels $1,2,4,5,6,7$ respectively.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-PARITY-EXPOSURE270: exact source-bit disclosure and cached both-label ordinary children (31 October 2026, 05:00 PDT).}

$\bigoplus_i b_i=0$; SAT members have eight models and UNSAT members zero.

one $b_i$. Therefore deterministic adaptive \emph{cold source-bit} decision-tree
complexity of the SAT label, and a parity-selected bit in a physically constant-size
ordinary SAT child, is \emph{exactly} $m$ on the declared promise.
A fully charged source scan and one persistent parity bit, however, amortize
repeated child reads: the naive $q m$ repeated cold-source tariff is invalid.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-ADAPTIVE-COFACTOR-MASS269: universal raw-cofactor survival invariant for deterministic adaptive source-aware branch trees (31 October 2026, 04:10 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM} for clause falsification by uniform complete assignments and exact Shannon polarity; \textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent mathematical referee pending} for a tree-wide mass identity. For every proper original width-$w$ CNF $F$ with $m$ clauses and every finite deterministic \emph{source-aware, adaptively selected, early-terminal} binary branch tree whose coherent leaves partition the complete assignment cube, let $R(\rho)$ count original clauses not yet satisfied by leaf cube $\rho$, including now-empty clauses. If $u_j(\rho)$ is the number of unset literals in a surviving source clause, then
\[
\sum_{\ell}2^{-|\rho_\ell|}R(\rho_\ell)=
\sum_{j=1}^m2^{-|C_j|}
+\sum_\ell2^{-|\rho_\ell|}
\sum_{j:C_j\text{ survives }\rho_\ell}(1-2^{-u_j(\rho_\ell)}).
\]
In particular $\max_\ell R(\rho_\ell)\ge m/2^w$. Thus a \emph{pure raw original-clause cofactor tree}, keeping all surviving clause records at every leaf, cannot make \emph{all} raw children $o(m)$ clauses merely by arbitrary adaptive pivots. This is classical averaging and a restricted source-accounting obstruction, \emph{not} computational hardness: the large residual may contain an empty source clause and be an immediate, cheap original-source UNSAT terminal. Structural solvers, guard-based pruning, arbitrary representation changes and physical post-simplification children escape this \emph{raw-count} hypothesis.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL.} Two independent JavaScript implementations exhaustively verified ten source CNFs (8 SAT, 2 UNSAT), including H7/H8, XOR both labels, signed renaming, Horn, dual-Horn, Krom and dense seeded CNF. Sixty adaptive source-aware decision-tree controls partitioned 284 leaf cubes, with exact dyadic tree mass identity, 756 four-way original indexed SS/SU/US/UU pair modes, 448 triple modes, 16,896 flip-clause updates, 176 occurrence inversion records and 92 original-resolution prohibited cubes. Same-source SAT and UNSAT labels were independently enumerated. A fixed-policy source-aware controller searched 78 nodes and recorded 2,525 selected operations versus 44 nodes and 816 selected operations for standard UP-DPLL, with no demonstrated speedup or native-FLMV comparability. Shallow guest controls \emph{materialized and reparsed} thirteen ordinary ASCII-DIMACS children, including two globally UNSAT sources; output length 441 characters total, 245 additional source-literal construction reads, 183 guest-literal reads. The full original-indexed raw JSON (488,349 characters, including 15 independently checked byte-exact physical children: 10 SAT and 5 UNSAT), both executable checkers, and formal report were committed with exact readback. Large retained host arrays prevent any claim of $N^{1/2}$ FLMV space.

\textbf{CORPUS RECONCILIATION.} Reuses authenticated predecessor LSPV-1 AFFINE-CUBE-DUAL268/PRIME-CHAIN267/PIVOT-ANTICHAIN265 and peer LSPV-2 LAZY-INTERFACE-ACCESS269, LSPV-3 INTERFACE-SOURCE-SELECTOR-GATE272, LSPV-4 PARETO269 and LSPV-5 MAIN239. \paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-AFFINE-CUBE-DUAL268: certified affine residual cubes and exact pin-descriptor admission (31 October 2026, 03:10 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM} (linear-algebra consistency duality and XOR truth-table encodings); \textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted, independent mathematical referee pending}. For an authenticated original proper-3CNF made from disjoint-private XOR components with shared boundary $B$, indexed source rows $V\in\mathbb F_2^{q\times b}$, and pins $r$, every boundary-only coherent source cube $\rho$ is UNSAT exactly when some $w\ne0$ annihilates the remaining free columns $V_U$ and satisfies $w^\top(r+V_J\rho)=1$. This is a sound source-scoped parity-combination rejection certificate with an exact converse, not an unrestricted SAT shortcut. The common-source pin-only decision $\operatorname{SAT}(F_{V,r})\Leftrightarrow(r=0^q\lor r=1^q)$ is correct \emph{for every pin vector} exactly when all rows of $V$ are the same nonzero vector; $V$ with different rows admits mixed-pin SAT and same-pin UNSAT counterexamples. For identical nonzero rows and equal pins, minimal boundary blockers are exactly the $2^{|\operatorname{supp}(v)|-1}$ wrong-parity full-support cubes. A SAT parent can have an UNSAT boundary cube, requiring scope guards. The earlier LSPV-2/4 canonical identical-parity pin-presence descriptor itself decides both SAT and UNSAT once fully source-authenticated, so MAIN238's restricted arbitrary-guest virtual-child composition remains correct but the guest call is optional; this does not close the all-input or hereditary ARC requirement.

Six original proper 3CNF sources (3 SAT/3 UNSAT) and three adverse controls (renamed SAT, H7 SAT, H8 UNSAT) passed independently. Fully retained original source S/U targets, their inversions, SS/SU/US/UU pair flags, complements, endpoint counts, flip trails and authenticated affine blockers were checked: 8884 pair modes, 69632 independent complete source assignments and four explicit guarded dual witnesses. Baseline DPLL selected event work was 17230 on the six sources, versus 742096 selected work for the template-discovery controller, including 12509 rejected candidates and 727704 candidate-generated literal events. No native FLMV speedup or simultaneous memory bound follows. The code, 547783-character original-indexed raw JSON, independent GF(2) checker and checker output were committed and verified by GitHub readback.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-AFFINE-CUBE-COVER261: source-relative cover versus power-short raw cofactors (30 October 2026, 20:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted syntactic-cover counting, independent referee pending; COMPUTATIONAL paired SAT/UNSAT controls; universal arbitrary-decider ARC OPEN.}
For $b\ge2$ source-disjoint three-variable XOR-parity blocks with alternating target parities, each block consists of four proper signed ternary clauses, each variable occurs twice positive and twice negative, and the original formula $F_b$ has $4^b$ models despite both coherent $0^{3b}$ and $1^{3b}$ assignments failing. For a model-compatible source-variable cube $\rho$, raw syntactic restriction leaving $c$ nonempty original clauses retains at most $2^{\lfloor c/2\rfloor}$ original models; hence any \emph{source-relative model-cover} family of $q$ such children with $c\le s$ satisfies
\[
q\ge 4^b/2^{\lfloor s/2\rfloor}.
\]
With explicit source length $N=\Theta(b\log b)$, children of physical length $\le N^\lambda$ for fixed $\lambda<1$ have $s=o(b)$, forcing $q\ge2^{2b-o(b)}$ \emph{only for this source-cover raw-cofactor architecture}. This rules out a purported polynomial-query syntactic cover compressor, not any semantic simplification, authenticated SAT witness, XOR/2SAT recognizer, or arbitrary SAT decider. The family is an intentionally easy affine adversarial control; no SAT lower bound follows. The companion UNSAT source adds the four opposite-parity original clauses on one block, with a seven-step source-resolution refutation.

\paragraph{ARC-CUBE-FAITHFUL-PROJECTION259: exact contextual encoding and paid certification (30 October 2026, 18:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT elementary source-projection theorem and KNOWN quantified-CNF hardness transfer, independent referee pending.}
For original CNF $F(X)$ and an auxiliary encoding $E(X,Y)$, correctness
on \emph{every} coherent source partial cube $\rho$ is equivalent to
\[
\forall a\in\{0,1\}^X:
 F(a)\longleftrightarrow\exists b\in\{0,1\}^Y E(a,b).
\]
With this pointwise source projection, any source-only clause $D$ satisfies
$E|_\rho\models D\iff F\models B_\rho\vee D$, where $B_\rho$
blocks $\rho$. Root equisatisfiability alone does not license
guarded deductions exported from an encoded residual. In the proper-3CNF
example $F\equiv w$, $E$ has an auxiliary projection
$w\wedge(z\vee x_1\vee\neg x_2)$: the source endpoints
$x_1x_2=00,11$ are extendible, but the interior source pin
$(x_1,x_2,z,w)=(0,1,0,1)$ satisfies $F$ and refutes $E$.
Thus endpoint tests cannot certify safe switching. Via a polynomial
source-preserving reduction from $\forall X\exists Y$-3SAT,
recognizing \emph{generic} all-cube faithfulness for proper ternary
CNF pairs is $\Pi_2^P$-complete even with both root formulas SAT.
This is a certification/discovery obstacle, not an unconditional
arbitrary-SAT lower bound, and syntactically certified encodings escape
generic verification.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} The independently replayed suite tested all 256
signed three-variable CNF subsets, finding 81 universally extendible
and 175 nonuniversal instances; 8,192 exact complete-source
projection checks used 9,218 decision calls and 20,613 DPLL nodes.
Three same-source SAT/SAT-bad, SAT/SAT-faithful and UNSAT/UNSAT
controls exhaustively checked 243 partial cubes each, with respectively
6, 0, 0 contextual mismatches. The original clause-indexed S/U and
four-mode compatibility audits, both coherent endpoint assignments,
complements, intermediate flips and a source-indexed proof blocker are
retained only as adversarial controls. The encoded trial used more
selected DPLL work on both labels; no native FLMV time or peak
writable-space improvement was measured.

\textbf{OPEN:} A single hereditary, fully paid, all-input ordinary
SAT arbitrary-decider $A\mapsto\Phi(A)$ producing physically
power-short ordinary children, maintaining sound source-cube semantics
under all adaptive policy switches, and reaching the same-machine
actual-FLMV simultaneous time--space forbidden region, remains

\paragraph{ARC-ASSUMPTION-SCOPE258: source-authenticated conditional clause reuse (30 October 2026, 17:25 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN propositional deduction/assumption rule with independently
checked source-paired COMPUTATIONAL controls; referee review pending.}
For any original CNF $F$, coherent partial assignment $\rho$, source
blocking clause $B_\rho$ and candidate clause $D$,
\[
F\upharpoonright\rho\models D
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
F\models B_\rho\vee D,\qquad
F\upharpoonright\rho\text{ UNSAT}
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad F\models B_\rho.
\]
A residual policy may export a source-checked conditional clause
to a different policy or restart only after adding its assumption
guard. UNSAT needs a genuine replayable source refutation; a bounded
search timeout is UNRESOLVED. The tiny SAT formula
$(x\vee y)\wedge(x\vee\neg y)$ is UNSAT under $x=0$ and therefore
produces the sound global blocker $x$; unguarded export of the local
units $y$ and $\neg y$ falsely turns the original SAT source into
UNSAT. An original-clause pair sharing same-polarity $x$ and
opposite-polarity $y$ has no SS/SU/US/UU simultaneous extremes,
yet both original clauses are disjunctively SAT when $x=1$.
The full eight signed ternary-clause UNSAT source has minimum UP
split-refutation depth two, so bounded local proof recognition is
sound but incomplete. These are standard logical rules, not a new
algorithm or hardness result.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} 256 proper signed three-variable original
formula subsets, 27 coherent cubes and 27 target clauses each:
186,624 independently checked contextual/global entailment
equivalences and 1,492,992 complete valuations. An independent
Node.js checker agrees. On 23 additional original SAT/UNSAT

\paragraph{ARC213: exact 2SAT/XOR compatibility firewall (28 October, 22:00).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, KNOWN THEOREM (Schaefer mixed-CSP context), peer review pending.}
Every signed 3-clause
$\ell_1\vee\ell_2\vee\ell_3$ has the exact existential
projection
$\exists y_1y_2y_3
\bigl[\bigwedge_{i=1}^3(\ell_i\vee y_i)\ \wedge\
(y_1\oplus y_2\oplus y_3=0)\bigr]$.
This uniform explicit reduction gives $3m$ binary clauses, $m$
disjoint XOR3 constraints and $3m$ fresh bits from an arbitrary
$m$-clause 3CNF, preserving both SAT and UNSAT. Consequently,
even the restricted mixed 2SAT-plus-XOR language is NP-complete,
although each component alone is polynomial-time decidable.

separate binary-CNF and XOR consistency. All eight signed clauses on

binary part is SAT with all fresh bits one and its XOR part SAT
with all fresh bits zero. This is not an unconditional time lower
bound against adaptive coupled solvers. The reduction physically
\emph{grows} the 86-byte sample to 352 bytes and gives no
$N^\lambda$ child. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} 512 local gadget truth
rows, 256 source subsets, 2048 source assignments, 8768 small

\paragraph{ARC214: mixed 2SAT/XOR treewidth preservation (28 October, 23:00).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT for the explicitly declared mixed primal-constraint
graph, independent review pending.}
For the ARC213 clause gadget with each private auxiliary in one binary
clause and one ternary XOR constraint, contracting each auxiliary
$y_i$ into its source variable recovers exactly the source primal graph.
Conversely, to every supplied source tree decomposition of width $w$,
attach a three-bag path of scopes
$\{a,b,c,y_1\}$,
$\{b,c,y_1,y_2\}$,
$\{c,y_1,y_2,y_3\}$
at a source bag containing clause variables $a,b,c$.
Consequently, writing $P$ for primal scope graphs with parity-triangle
edges included,
\[
\operatorname{tw}(P(F))\le
\operatorname{tw}(P(G_F))\le
\max\{\operatorname{tw}(P(F)),3\}.
\]
For source treewidth at least three, the optimal widths are equal. The additive constant is \emph{sharp}: two distinct proper signed clauses $(a\vee b\vee c)$ and $(\neg a\vee b\vee c)$ have source primal width two, but their mixed graph contains a subdivided triangular prism and hence a $K_4$ minor, giving width three. Omitting XOR-scope edges falsely lowers the width to one.
Known exact Boolean-factor dynamic programming is polynomial on
polynomially constructible logarithmic-width decompositions, but
\emph{no all-input small-width decomposition or rank descent is provided}.
The gadget adds $3m$ variables and does not physically shrink
arbitrary instances. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} independent reproducer
checked 95 valid lifted decompositions, 543 actual edge contractions,
1752 original assignments with 38719 auxiliary probes, 92 joint
factor-elimination trials including a complete eight-clause UNSAT
control, and 8684 candidate table rows, plus an explicit sharpness control. Source-only archive audit
counts from ARC210 remain prior results, not rerun in ARC214.

and P versus NP remain \OPEN.

\paragraph{ARC217: guarded one-bit contextual projection (29 October, 01:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/RESTRICTED, independent review pending.}
A uniform $O((n+m)\log(n+m+2))$-bit mixed 2CNF--XOR3
construction maps any $3$CNF $F$ to an instance $H_F$
which is \emph{always satisfiable}, with a fixed witness at
the control bit $g=1$, but whose exact externally projected
one-bit relation is
\[
 \exists x,y,t\,H_F(g,x,y,t)
 \equiv
 \begin{cases}
 1,&F\in\mathrm{SAT},\\
 g,&F\notin\mathrm{SAT}.
 \end{cases}
\]
The local per-clause gadget uses $(\ell_i\vee y_i)$ and
$y_1\oplus y_2\oplus t=t\oplus y_3\oplus g=0$.
Thus deciding whether $g=0$ extends is NP-complete, and
testing whether the guaranteed-satisfiable instance entails $g=1$
is coNP-complete.  Contextual exact-summary \emph{acquisition},
even when the external interface has one bit, cannot be treated
as free.  Importantly, the binary/affine syntactic overlap is
$3m$ fresh $y$ variables, not one; the pinned affine nullity is
$2m$, so ARC215/ARC216 are unaffected.  Since $H_F$ itself is
always SAT, a \emph{decision-only} successor may output fixed
YES; no all-input SAT-compression or unconditional lower bound
follows.  Finite checks passed: $256$ signed-clause subsets,
$4096$ global guard rows, and $240$ random formulas
($208$ SAT, $32$ UNSAT), plus local and hostile controls.

\paragraph{ARC220: paid dual-parameter source-certified certificate selector (29 October, 04:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/RESTRICTED (independent review pending).}

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC237: sharp nonlinear-preprocessing one-probe frontier (29 October 2026, 19:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, RESTRICTED; independent referee pending.}

and an arbitrary parity continuation $B_{w,t}$ chosen \emph{after}
preprocessing, an arbitrary deterministic \emph{nonlinear} fixed-length
$L$-bit summary, even with unrestricted temporary preprocessing,
cannot answer every later parity mask using at most one additional
original-source sign-bit probe unless
\[
 \boxed{L\ge b-\lfloor\log_2(b+1)\rfloor.}
\]
This lower bound is sharp for every $b$: store $b-r$ dot products
with a basis of $\ker G$, where $r=\lfloor\log_2(b+1)\rfloor$ and
the public $r\times b$ matrix $G$ contains every nonzero $r$-bit
column. For future mask $w$, $Gw$ identifies either a stored
kernel parity or one original sign $a_i$ to probe. The lower bound
uses arbitrary nonlinear summary fibers: if the affine span of one
fiber has dimension $r_s$, then $2^{r_s}$ parity classes modulo
constants must fit among at most $b+1$ one-probe coordinate classes,
so every fiber has size at most $b+1$. In the indexed bit-RAM
construction, $P=O(b^3)$ conservative bit operations (including $b$
source reads), persistent $L=b-r$, $Q\le1$ original-source probe,
online work $O(b^3)$, and temporary workspace $O(b^2)$.
The original $N=\Theta(b\log(b+2))$ source bits remain physically
present. \textbf{No} one-tape/multitape runtime or unrestricted
SAT hardness bound is implied. The prior LSPV-2
CONTEXTUAL-VALUE-HAMMING235 proved a sharper per-mask theorem for
fixed \emph{linear} summaries; ARC237 extends the sharp $Q\le1$
storage endpoint to all nonlinear preprocessors, without external
mathematical priority claims. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} 87,380 exhaustive
$(a,w)$ checks for $b\le8$, 256 nonlinear 1-bit source maps for

\subsection*{ARC238: adaptive nonlinear contextual-summary probe frontier}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted; independent referee review pending.}
For a unary signed source $A_a(X)=\bigwedge_{i=1}^b(x_i=a_i)$ prepared
before a later arbitrary parity context
$B_{w,t}(X,Z)=[\langle w,X\rangle=t]$, suppose every bit of the
source-dependent persistent summary is counted in length $L$.
An online exact deterministic decoder may adaptively probe at most
$Q$ named original sign bits, with unbounded other local computation.
For every nonlinear preparation and adaptive decoder,
\[
 2^L\sum_{j=0}^{Q}\binom bj\ge2^b,
 \qquad
 L\ge b-\left\lfloor\log_2\sum_{j=0}^{Q}\binom bj\right\rfloor.
\]
The proof uses the degree-$Q$ Walsh-character span of adaptive
coordinate decision trees on each summary fiber: all restricted parity
characters span the full real function space of the fiber. Thus each
fiber contains at most $\sum_{j=0}^{Q}\binom bj$ sources. The $Q=1$
case was already ARC237; the general $Q$ inequality is the new scoped
claim. The known binary Golay $[23,12,7]$ perfect code meets equality at
$(b,L,Q)=(23,12,3)$; source-authenticated direct products attain
$(L,Q)=(12r,3r)$ at $b=23r$ with polynomially charged indexed RAM work.
A reproducible finite certificate checked all 2,048 Golay syndromes,
5,000 source/query comparisons and 3,289 small linear codes, plus

\paragraph{EXTREME-SIGNED-CYCLE240 (29 October, 21:56 PDT; source-indexed signed extremes).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, elementary identities; independent referee pending.}
For each original proper signed width-three clause \(C_j\), the local
all-literals-true target \(S_j\) and all-literals-false target \(U_j\)
are complementary \emph{partial cubes} on the original variables,
not independently chosen signed-occurrence bits.
Any two original clauses sharing variable \(x_i\) have compatible
local extreme labels \(e_j,e_k\in\{0,1\}\) precisely when
\(e_j\oplus e_k=\nu_{ij}\oplus\nu_{ik}\), with \(\nu_{ij}\)
the negated-occurrence indicator. Thus \(SS,UU\) require no
opposite-sign overlap, and \(SU,US\) no same-sign overlap.
A signed clause-overlap multigraph retaining \emph{every} shared-variable
parity edge characterizes global extreme patterns: a chosen clause set
admits one legal all-extreme assignment iff every induced signed cycle
has parity zero. Let \(\tau_{\mathrm{bal}}\) be the minimum number
of clause vertices deleted to balance this graph. Then
\[
\min_a\bigl(N_1(a)+N_2(a)\bigr)=\tau_{\mathrm{bal}},
\qquad
\max_a N_3(a)=\max_a N_0(a)=\alpha(H_F),
\]
where \(H_F\) is the standard opposite-polarity conflict graph
(Kullmann). The first equality follows by deleting the middle clauses
from any assignment and conversely realizing all undeleted balanced
extreme labels; the second follows from conflict-independent sets
being precisely those whose literals can all be simultaneously true.
This is \emph{not} a SAT or UNSAT certificate or an efficient
algorithm for general SAT. An odd-parity three-clause signed cycle
has pairwise compatible \(SU/US\) labels but cannot have all
three clauses extreme, although its zero and one assignments can
both satisfy the formula; a mixed same/opposite overlap pair can have
all four extremes impossible while its \emph{disjunctions} both hold.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL, deterministic finite controls.} The seed-20261029
reproducer passed 12,640 exhaustive source-indexed pair-state comparisons,
700 exact signed-graph assignment checks, 22,400 complement checks,
66,816 per-clause flip-count identities, and 240 extremum/graph tests.
Source-authenticated width-\(\le2\) resolution can certify forbidden
partial cubes, e.g.\ clauses \((x_1\lor x_2\lor x_3)\) and
\((x_1\lor x_2\lor\neg x_3)\) imply \((x_1\lor x_2)\).
In a fixed-order unit-propagating DPLL control, saturated resolution
reduced an 8-clause UNSAT case from 31 recursive states to one but
increased the instrumented work from 1,056 to 36,670 primitive charges;
hence search-node savings alone are not net work savings.
No industrial CDCL, native tape runtime, or peak physical RAM
comparison is claimed. The complete local code and raw JSON are
not falsely represented as GitHub-published; the verified compact
GitHub checker and data excerpt are cited below. The original
unsimplified source remains available to every algorithm.
Both P$=$NP and P$\ne$NP remain \textbf{OPEN}.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 EXTREME-BALANCE-UP-FIREWALL248: two additive original-clause extreme prunes are dominated by unit propagation (30 October 2026, 04:04 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted to the defined counting tests; independent referee pending.}
Let $\rho$ be a coherent partial assignment of original source variables; let $Z$ count original clauses with no pinned true literal after restriction. For every free original variable $v$, let $p_v,q_v$ be its positive and negative counts in those residual clauses. The sign-sensitive upper capacity $H=\sum_v\max\{p_v,q_v\}$ obeys
\[
  H<Z\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{ordinary source UP from $\rho$ refutes $\rho$}.
\]
Indeed, at every noncontradictory UP fixed point every residual clause has at least two free literals, hence $H\ge\tfrac12\sum_v(p_v+q_v)\ge Z$. A deficit $H<Z$ persists under each forced unit assignment until an empty source clause appears. The same domination holds when $H$ is applied to any subset of the residual clauses.

For a proper uniform width-$k$ sign-balanced CNF with $d_v$ positive and $d_v$ negative original occurrences for each variable, set $B=m(k-2)/2$, $D=\sum_{v\text{ free}}d_v$ and $\Theta=\sum_j\max(0,a_j(\rho)-1)$, where $a_j(\rho)$ is the number of already pinned-true literals of original $C_j$. Exact source-occurrence conservation gives
\[
 \boxed{\Theta=B-D+Z,\qquad H\le D,\qquad
 \Theta>B\Longrightarrow H<Z\Longrightarrow\mathrm{UP}\text{ contradiction}.}
\]
For strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ proper 3CNF this is $\Theta=m/2-2u+Z$, with $u$ free original variables. Hence neither additive test can reject a new partial cube after unit propagation, despite being logically sound earlier in the search. No claim is made about correlated higher-order deductions, resolution, or arbitrary SAT algorithms.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL / FALSIFIED/RETIRED.}
The source-indexed tester generated both local all-TRUE and all-FALSE original-clause targets with inversions, checked $SS/SU/US/UU$ modes, coherent $0^n/1^n$ and multivariable flip trails, non-tautological original-source resolvent forbidden cubes, and SAT/UNSAT DPLL controls. Independent controls: 1,632 clause-pair modes, 65,600 coherent complete assignments, 72 source-resolvent cube tests, 28,287 sampled partial cubes and 17 balanced-family instances. Of 12,390 $H<Z$ triggers, zero survived UP closure. On W1 strict22 UNSAT and SWAP6 strict22 SAT, a post-UP redundant counting controller retained respectively $151$ and $78$ DPLL nodes, but increased selected logical events $13{,}286\to17{,}941$ and $6{,}741\to9{,}322$. Tests are not general machine lower bounds. Original parent clauses of sharp strict22 source $C_3=(x_6\vee\neg x_3\vee x_5)$ and $C_4=(x_6\vee x_3\vee\neg x_4)$ give source resolvent $(x_6\vee x_5\vee\neg x_4)$ and forbid $x_4=1,x_5=x_6=0$, already refuted by UP. This falsifies any alleged post-UP extra pruning by these additive criteria.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 ARC-GUEST-QUERY-SPECTRUM250: completed-call size-frequency firewall (30 October 2026, 12:00 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT in a restricted opaque, timing-insensitive completed guest-CALL model, independent review pending.}
Suppose an arbitrary fixed correct SAT guest $A_0$ with unknown polynomial exponents $(K_0,L_0)$ can be DELAY-wrapped to make each ordinary child call of size $m$ require at least $m^D$ physical steps for any fixed integer $D$. For a fixed code-opaque, guest-timing-insensitive hereditary compiler claiming
$K'\le\max\{\alpha,\gamma+\lambda\max(K_0,D)\}$ on every wrapper, $0<\lambda<1$, any infinite source sequence with $N^{\theta-o(1)}$ completed guest calls each of length $N^{\eta-o(1)}$ requires

\theta+D\eta\le\max\{\alpha,\gamma+\lambda\max(K_0,D)\}
\quad\text{for each fixed integer }D.
\]
Consequently $\eta\le\lambda$, and if $\eta=\lambda$ then $\theta\le\gamma$. The full frequency condition is
$\limsup_N\log_N\sum_i m_{i,N}^{D}\le\max\{\alpha,\gamma+\lambda\max(K_0,D)\}$.
This strengthens the preexisting single-long-query DELAY firewall only for the declared completed-call interface, \emph{not for arbitrary code-inspecting, timing-dependent or preempting SAT compilers}. A simultaneously buffered $N^\theta$ disjoint physical child payloads of $N^\eta$ bits requires $N^{\theta+\eta-o(1)}$ counted writable bits. \paragraph{Decision-only UNSAT absorbing-prefix counterfamily (PROVED/EXACT scoped, external referee pending).}
The previous bounded-error payload floor is an \emph{SAT-accepting-input}
statement and cannot be promoted to every UNSAT original. Fix the independently
certified proper monotone D\"ocker $U198$ UNSAT source (264 signed original clauses)
and the valid 9-variable SAT $F9$. For $t\ge0$, form the valid canonical original

and $m_t=264+12t$. One fixed, all-binary-input correct deterministic decider
first parses the two gamma headers and checks only these 264 source records;
if they match, it rejects, even if the rest of the input is malformed;
otherwise it fully authenticates and exhaustively decides. Therefore on each
valid UNSAT $F_t$ it reads exactly
$|\gamma(n_t)|+|\gamma(m_t)|+264(1+3\lceil\log_2(n_t+1)\rceil)$ source bits,
which is $O(\log N_t)$ for full length $N_t=\Theta(t\log t)$.
A conservative indexed-tape implementation charges $O(\log^2N_t)$ native
time and $O(\log N_t)$ simultaneous writable/index bits on the fast path.
This is one uniform finite machine, NOT the previously known POINTINF1
per-length hardwiring trick and NOT a general SAT or UNSAT fast algorithm.

$\Omega(N^\epsilon)$ decision-work or grammar-read floor.

\paragraph{LSPV-1 OCCURRENCE-AWARE-SECOND-BATCH326 (November 2, 2026, 04:04 PST).}
For a normalized ordinary CNF with max width $w\ge2$, at most $P$ occurrences of each variable polarity, and primal max degree $d$, a primal-independent exact Davis--Putnam batch gives
\[
\boxed{\Delta'\le d+2P(P(w-1)-1)},\qquad P'\le P^2,\quad w'\le2(w-1).
\]
The previous individual-pivot claim of at most $P(w-1)$ newly introduced neighbors is \emph{false} when the same survivor $y$ shares both $x$-positive and $x$-negative parents. \[
q_x-1\le s_x(P(w-1)-1),\qquad \sum_{x\in I}s_x\le2P;
\]

\paragraph{LSPV-2 GAMMA-SUFFIX-INDEX289 (31 October 2026, 22:16 PDT): \textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted indexed child-bit lemma, independently checked finite physical events; arbitrary-$A$ ARC, FLMV transport and P versus NP OPEN}.}
A fixed $16$-bit $n,m$ header used in earlier finite benchmarks cannot be an asymptotically unbounded NP-complete representation: its valid strings have $n\le49{,}149$ and $m\le65{,}532$.
We therefore provided an unbounded $\gamma(n)\gamma(m)$ Elias-gamma header and a certified source-valid trailing-$Y_6$ removal rule.
For any validated target $F=H\wedge Y_6$ whose final eight original indexed clauses use only the last six variables, the canonical child $H$ is in the same target and $\operatorname{SAT}(F)\iff\operatorname{SAT}(H)$.
With parent/child gamma-header lengths $h_P,h_C$, widths $w_P,w_C$ and clause-record widths $r_P=1+3w_P$, $r_C=1+3w_C$, child bit $q\ge h_C$ determines $j=\lfloor(q-h_C)/r_C\rfloor$ and $t=(q-h_C)\bmod r_C$.
At $t=0$ its source address is $h_P+jr_P$; otherwise the exact original-source address is
\[
h_P+jr_P+1+\left\lfloor\frac{t-1}{w_C}\right\rfloor w_P+(w_P-w_C)+((t-1)\bmod w_C).
\]
This uses $O(\log N)$ writable scratch and one original indexed bit per nonheader output bit, including width transitions $4\to3$, $5\to4$, and $9\to8$.
Fully charged recognition can use $O(\log N)$ writable space with repeated scans but has only a $N^{2+o(1)}$ time upper bound, not the required ARC local time.

\paragraph{LSPV-2 PRODUCT-PROBE280 (31 October 2026, 13:12 PDT): \textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted query adversary and batching; COMPUTATIONAL independently checked controls; universal ARC/FLMV OPEN}.}
A grammar-valid two-positive-occurrence switch at original indices 2 and 44 separates the original U198 UNSAT source from a verified same-size V198 SAT source. For every $k$, the $k$-block V-product is SAT, while replacing any one block by U makes it UNSAT, with only two distinct encoded bit positions changed in that block. Every deterministic exact indexed-bit target decider on the all-V input must inspect at least one position from every block, requiring $k=\Omega(N/\log N)$ source-bit probes in this fixed-template family. This is a standard decision-tree argument and not a superlinear SAT lower bound.
\par
In the same \emph{easy, restricted, ordered fixed-template family}, grouping consecutive components gives exact canonical, both-label-correct children with physical lengths at most $\sqrt{N}$ for $k\ge2732$ under the declared gamma-header clause-list encoding, and asymptotically $N^{1/2+o(1)}$ sequential children. The first qualifying source has $N=43{,}996{,}206$ bits and one-block child length 6,632 bits. A source-streaming recognizer reads and pays for the complete parent; the indexed child-bit accessor rebases identifiers after $O(\log N)$ parent-bit reads per requested field. This \emph{does not} solve connected instances or malformed/non-promise all-target inputs, does not lower arbitrary guest workspace, and does not transfer the numerical FLMV boundary.
\par
The new independent checker verified 309,764 fully materialized child-bit positions, 1,860 sampled virtual large-$k$ accesses, 277,728 original-clause pair extreme modes and 1,584 signed S/U occurrence inversions. \paragraph{LSPV-2 COMPONENT-CLOSURE-HEREDITY279 (31 October 2026, 12:12 PDT): \textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted source-faithful syntax; independently verified finite controls; universal ARC/FLMV OPEN}.}

component hub for disconnected ordinary sources (including unit,
binary, empty, duplicate, and tautological clause controls), and
retains every original source variable as a physically named free
port via deterministic clone renaming.  The resulting \emph{connected}
proper strict signed exact22 formula $C(F)$ obeys the pointwise identity
\[
  \forall\xi\in\{0,1\}^n:\quad
  \exists Z\,C(F)(\xi,Z)\ \Longleftrightarrow\ F(\xi),
\]
without a SAT-solving call, for both SAT and UNSAT sources.
The known two-swap guard additionally transports exact equality to
a fresh physical port, at an increasing encoded-size cost.
For a normalizer intermediate with $M$ clauses and $g\le9M$
transparent occurrence pads, the output has exactly $9(M+7g)$
variables and $12(M+7g)$ clauses; total encoded output is polynomial
but not power-short.
A separate \textbf{PROVED/RESTRICTED} physical floor applies to
\emph{every} strict exact22 output retaining $n$ distinct named free
ports in ASCII DIMACS:
\[
 N_{\rm out}\ge32\sum_{j=1}^{n}
  (1+\lfloor\log_{10}j\rfloor)=\Omega(n\log n)\ \text{bits}.
\]
Thus on canonical connected bounded-occurrence families with
$N_{\rm in}=\Theta(n\log n)$ such all-port-preserving output
\emph{cannot} satisfy $N_{\rm out}\le N_{\rm in}^\lambda$
for any fixed $\lambda<1$ on unbounded inputs. This is an architectural
\emph{output-size} obstruction, not a runtime lower bound:
a correct answer-only child is free to forget the original ports.
Exhaustive $Q$ and guard fixtures, 10 hostile ordinary-source controls,
10 independent MILP cofactor checks, and a byte-identical independent
rerun of the 4,680/7,191/139 Connected Interface Audit are
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL} evidence. Source and full physical/machine ledgers:
\path{research/agents/lspv-2/2026-10-29_1312_LSPV-2_CONNECTED_ALLPORT_COMPILER224.tex}.
Independent referee and kernel verification are pending; uniform
charged semantic forgetting, one-child power contraction,
ARC-EDGE-90 and both sides of $P$ versus $NP$ remain \textbf{OPEN}.

\paragraph{PARITY-PORT-FORGETTING225: auxiliary-free projection versus forgetful collapse (29 October 2026).}
\textbf{PROVED/RESTRICTED}, independent referee pending.
For each $b\ge2$ and $t\in\{0,1\}$ an explicit connected proper
$4b$-clause ordinary 3CNF with $2b+1$ variables has exact external
relation $\bigoplus_{j=1}^b x_j=t$. Every auxiliary-free CNF for this
relation requires $2^{b-1}$ distinct width-$b$ clauses, whereas the
Tseitin extension-variable 3CNF is linear. Existentially forgetting
\emph{any one} free parity input makes the projected relation TRUE;
conjoining opposite parity targets on shared inputs remains UNSAT
under any such forgetting. Thus local variable count, exact projection
size, and physical re-entry size are distinct resources. Applying the
previously established connected all-port exact22 compiler preserves
the pointwise relation but \emph{expands} measured source bit lengths:
for $b=3,4,6$, $(1016,56176)$, $(1320,62128)$,
$(2128,74032)$ (ordinary parent, strict22 all-port child).
The named-port lower bound strengthens quantitatively: retaining $r$
distinct strict22 physical ports costs $\Omega(r\log r)$ ASCII bits,
so with $N=\Theta(b\log b)$, power contraction requires
$r=O(b^\lambda/(\log b)^{1-\lambda})$ \emph{when physical port retention
is required}; answer-only descendants need not retain those ports.
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL}: 16 source controls, 3064 boundary assignments,
248 complete hidden-variable enumerations, 13824 forget-pair checks,
and an independent byte-identical 4680/7191/139 connected-interface
archive audit; raw SHA256 \path{20646d178a5cedca3ba67f312e73a2d14f3fe9c44379c2be0910af355973159c}.

\paragraph{LSPV-2, ONE-SHOT-PARITY-PADDING226 (29 October 2026; restricted theorem, independent referee pending).}
The fully explicit connected proper ordinary-3CNF parity-padding family
$P(H)$ takes any arbitrary connected proper 3SAT core $H$ with $m$
clauses and attaches $\max(2,m^2)$ fresh XOR inputs to one original
variable, encoded by four ternary clauses per gate. For every assignment
to the original core variables, forgetting one private parity input
and all internal chain wires projects $P(H)$ exactly to $H$. The
canonical one-child extractor validates every source clause and is
polynomial-time, answer-oblivious and correct on both SAT and UNSAT.
The promised padded family is NP-complete yet its child has physical
bit length at most $N^{3/4}$ for $m\ge4096$. Crucially the child $H$
need not be in the padded family; canonical re-padding gives the
two-cycle $P(H)\to H\to P(H)$, hence no decreasing descent rank.
This is an elementary padding/closure counterexample, not a new
general SAT algorithm or an all-algorithm lower bound. The independent
finite audit verified 14 growing SAT/UNSAT controls, 592 small
pointwise projections and five malformed inputs; the original
Connected Interface Audit matched its archived JSON byte for byte.

\paragraph{LSPV-2, TWO-UNIVERSE-CROSS-SPINE227 (29 October 2026; conditional synthesis and computational controls).}
The two conditional universes were audited against both the
constructive single-child and the FLMV/Williams separation spines.
\textbf{PREVIOUSLY PROVED}: RACE77 shows that a correct total
deterministic SAT decider with a uniform polynomial runtime bound on
\emph{either} the SAT side or the UNSAT side alone gives $P=NP$ by
opposite-answer timeout. ARC207 establishes that an arbitrary-input,
uniform, recursively closed, physically $N^\lambda$-short
($\lambda<1$), answer-preserving one-child algorithm with polynomial
full cost is equivalent to $P=NP$. The converse uses a presumed
polynomial SAT decider and is not an unconditional construction.
ONE-SHOT-PARITY-PADDING226 remains an NP-complete non-closed
counterexample compatible with both hypothetical worlds.

\textbf{CONDITIONAL numerical tests}: a materialized source-to-exact22
entry exponent $\alpha$ followed by a child exponent $\lambda$ yields
a strict power-size upper contraction only if $\alpha\lambda<1$,
assuming polylogarithmic overhead. If a virtual child has length
$N^\alpha$, construction cost $N^c$, child-solver time $M^d$, and
per-access cost $N^u$, the naive fully paid time upper exponent is
$\max(c,\alpha d+u)$, with the native and simultaneous peak-workspace
bound still to be proved. Williams excludes a correct random-access
SAT algorithm with $N^{o(1)}$ workspace and time exponent below
$2\cos(\pi/7)\approx1.80194$; an assumed $P=NP$ decider has an
\emph{unknown} polynomial exponent and need not inhabit this forbidden
region. The compiler224 all-port $\Omega(n\log n)$ physical floor
applies in both universes, whereas answer-preserving semantic forgetting
may evade it. Hirahara's unconditional P-immunity concerns
superpolynomial-time-bounded random strings; $P=NP$ does not put that
predicate in coNP via a polynomial simulation, and the polynomial
defining-time case has an unbounded search-exponent gap.

\paragraph{LSPV-2, TWO-PROBE-NONLINEAR-FRONTIER237 (29 October 2026, 19:12 PDT; exact restricted reusable summary).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, RESTRICTED; independent referee pending.}
For every $b$-bit unary-CNF source retained in indexed read-only storage
and every future parity mask unknown at preprocessing time, arbitrary
deterministic nonlinear fixed-length summaries and arbitrary adaptive
$Q$-bit source-probe continuation satisfy
\[
2^L\sum_{j=0}^{Q}\binom{b}{j}\ge 2^b.
\]
Each summary fiber supports all restricted Fourier characters, which
span the full space of real-valued functions on that fiber; each depth-$Q$
bit decision tree is a real polynomial of degree at most $Q$, giving
the stated dimension upper bound.  On the infinite, \emph{realized}
family $b=2(2^m-1)$, $m\ge1$, this bound is tight at $Q=2$:
\[
L_2(b)=b-2m.
\]
A uniform two-group XOR summary stores $b-2m$ physical bits and answers
any subsequent parity mask using at most one original-source bit in each
group. The exact first three fixed-length storage/probe Pareto points
are $(Q,L)=(0,b),(1,b-m),(2,b-2m)$, where the $Q=1$ point invokes the
already established NONLINEAR-ONE-PROBE236 theorem. For $b=14$, these
realizable points are $(0,14),(1,11),(2,8)$.

\textbf{MODEL FIREWALL:}
This is an \emph{indexed bit-RAM, reusable future-query} lower bound,
not a generic SAT decision-time bound. Preprocessing construction,
mask reading, cached synopsis, algebraic source reads and all address
arithmetic are charged; the source formula remains physically retained.
The construction has $P=O(N+bm)$ and per-query
$T=O(N+bm)$ for canonical $N=\Theta(b\log(b+1))$, stored bit length
$L=b-2m$, and $O(L+m+\log N)$ peak writable bits, separate from
immutable source $N$. Two random-access source probes do not transfer
to two sequential-tape reads. Arbitrary non-prefix variable-length
summaries are \emph{not} claimed optimal at $Q=2$; only the weaker
$(2^{L+1}-1)\sum_{j\le Q}\binom bj\ge2^b$ follows directly.
A joint SAT solver receiving source and future query together may
evaluate parity by a polynomial scan, without a reusable summary.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:}
The reproducible interpreter passed 4,112 exhaustive $(a,w)$ tests for
$b=2,6$, 70,216 larger tested pairs including all masks on four
$b=14$ source controls, 2,728 independent finite SAT-context checks,

\paragraph{LSPV-2, VARIABLE-LENGTH-SATURATION238 (29 October 2026, 20:17 PDT; exact restricted non-prefix saturation).}
\PROVED\ \RESTRICTED.  In a deterministic two-stage indexed bit-probe model,
preprocessing of a six-bit source (before a future arbitrary parity mask is known)
may produce an arbitrary nonlinear, non-prefix binary summary of maximum length $L$,
while continuation may adaptively probe at most two retained source-data bits.
The exact optimum is $L=2$.  The preceding degree-volume fiber ceiling is
$V(6,2)=22$; saturation forces orthogonality of the quadratic Walsh-evaluation
matrix, hence an orthogonal array of strength four, impossible since
$16\nmid22$.  Consequently every summary fiber has at most $21$ sources,
and three labels of length at most one cover at most $63<64$ source words.
Two cached triple parities with one raw bit probe per triple attain $L=2$
uniformly.  More generally, with
$V(b,Q)=\sum_{j=0}^{Q}\binom bj$, if
$2^{\min(2Q,b)}\nmid V(b,Q)$, a reusable summary fiber has size at most
$V(b,Q)-1$, improving the arbitrary-nonlinear degree-volume count.
\textbf{OPEN:} arbitrary-SAT/connected strict22 transport and all-algorithm
time--space implications; no generic SAT lower bound or $P$ versus $NP$ result
follows.  Complete standalone proof, executable, raw data, and independent-role
handoff:

\paragraph{LSPV-2, CONNECTED-LOG-FLIPS247 (30 October 2026; restricted).}
\PROVED\ (restricted, independent mathematical referee pending): For every coherent assignment of proper original width-three CNF with maximum source variable occurrence degree $d$ and every radius $0\le r\le n$, the \emph{complete aggregated} four-category histogram of all size-$r$ source-variable flips can be constructed in $f(r,d)(n+m)$ indexed-word-RAM arithmetic operations and working words. Define $Z_F(\mathbf u,\mathbf t)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\mathbf u_S\mathbf t^{\mathbf N(a\oplus S)-\mathbf N(a)}$. The ordinary formal logarithm has no monomial with disconnected support in the original variable co-occurrence graph; enumeration of connected supports and truncated formal exponentiation yields the exact histogram. A source-checked satisfying witness at radius $r$, when it exists, can be extracted with at most $n+1$ further conditioned compilations, charging each failed feasibility test. For fixed $r,d$ the histogram compiler is linear in source size; dependence $f(r,d)$ may be superpolynomial when $r$ grows with $n$. This is \emph{not} an all-input SAT decision theorem.
\COMPUTATIONAL\ independent tests: 12 named original-source controls, 219 signed clause-indexed ternary clauses, 2,839 pairwise $SS/SU/US/UU$ matrices checked against 149,320 coherent assignments, and 11,684 exhaustive radius-$r$ masks. The strict signed exact-$(2,2)$ W1 UNSAT instance has an independently replayed 76-leaf source-UP-DPLL refutation and all 32,768 assignments independently falsify the source. On W1, baseline 151 DPLL states and 0.026 seconds versus endpoint/cluster/fallback 151 states and 0.842 seconds; on $H_1$ SAT, baseline 7 DPLL states and 0.0006 seconds versus compiled witness without DPLL and 0.333 seconds. Thus a smaller search tree can cost more total time. Independent local $S/U$ and global coherent endpoint/flip analyses are distinct; the $O(m^2)$ pair matrix is not free solver preprocessing. Related bounded-degree coefficient algorithms are already known from Patel--Regts, and signed conflict matrices from Kullmann. Sources:

\paragraph{LSPV-2 DERIVATIVE-WITNESS248 (30 October 2026, 04:12 PDT; exact bounded-radius constructive theorem, independent referee pending).}
\PROVED\ \RESTRICTED: For a proper original 3-CNF of maximum variable occurrence $d$, the weighted radius-$r$ satisfying-flip polynomial
$P(\boldsymbol w)=\sum_{|S|=r,\ F(a\oplus S)=1}\prod_{i\in S}w_i$
admits an explicit source-indexed arithmetic circuit of $C=f(r,d)(n+m)$ gates using the verified connected-cluster expansion. For each already chosen flip set $T$,
$\partial_TP(\boldsymbol1)$ counts the still-viable satisfying radius-$r$ flips containing $T$, and
$\sum_{i\notin T}\partial_i\partial_TP(\boldsymbol1)=(r-|T|)\partial_TP(\boldsymbol1)$.
A forward nilpotent extension and reverse automatic differentiation therefore select a complete verified flip witness in at most $r$ passes, with $O(r3^r C+n+m)$ arithmetic operations and $O(2^r C+n+m)$ words, instead of the previous at-most-$n$ complete conditioned recompilations. The bound is linear in the source size for fixed $r,d$ only; all bit costs must be charged when $r$ grows, and general SAT remains open.

\COMPUTATIONAL: A separate source-indexed experiment first recorded every original clause's all-literals-true/false targets and inversions, $SS/SU/US/UU$ pairs, coherent global endpoints and multivariable flips, source-parent resolvents and excluded cubes. Fifteen adversarial SAT/UNSAT controls passed independent replay: 603 original signed occurrences, 1,522 clause-pair matrices, 69,928 pair-assignment checks, 1,805 radius masks, and 176,408 coherent source assignments. A strict exact-$(2+,2-)$ SAT source with both endpoints failing had 11 radius-2 satisfying flips; reverse differentiation required 2 gradient passes versus 14 separate conditioned evaluations. \FALSIFIED: fewer conditional recompilations do \emph{not} imply faster complete SAT decisions: the measured hybrid was slower and used more peak memory than UP--DPLL on this SAT source and the W1 strict22 UNSAT control, where fallback still visited 151 DPLL nodes. No equity scoring or universally applicable SAT lower bound is asserted. Both $P=NP$ and $P\ne NP$ remain \OPEN.

\paragraph{LSPV-2: BALANCED-TWO-COORD249 (2026-10-30 04:13 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted, independent referee pending.}
For any proper original ternary CNF with equal positive and negative occurrence
counts for each source variable, every coherent complete assignment satisfies
\[
N_1=\frac m2-2N_0+N_3,\qquad N_2=\frac m2+N_0-2N_3.
\]
Consequently all exact four-category changes under original-variable flip sets
are determined by the two coordinates $(\Delta N_0,\Delta N_3)$; a weighted
radius-$r$ Laurent encoding can replace the four formal variables with
$U=z_0z_2/z_1^2$ and $V=z_1z_3/z_2^2$.  The joint-label
box has at most $(2dr+1)^2$ potential indices when variables have degree at most
$d$; this is a representation theorem and \emph{not} a SAT time lower bound.
The two-coordinate linear rank is attained already by original single-variable
flips in the 15-variable W1 connected strict22 UNSAT source.  The prior LSPV-1
SAT-slice count identities and LSPV-2 connected-support compilation remain
valid and distinct.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL.} An independent source-only checker passed eight
SAT/UNSAT/2SAT/Horn/XOR/dense controls: 275 signed occurrences,
785 source pair matrices, 34,928 coherent pair assignments,
47,272 forbidden-cube extensions, 3,366 exact radius masks and
152 verified UNSAT proof leaves.  On balanced controls the sparse
two-coordinate and four-coordinate compilers executed the \emph{same}
number of nonzero term-pair multiplications: reducing coordinate labels
does not automatically reduce algebraic work.  W1 UP--DPLL stayed at
151 states with the two-coordinate compiler added, while end-to-end
runtime rose from 0.0173 to 0.0420 seconds on the tested Python
machine.  One-coordinate $N_0$ compilation can count SAT targets but
cannot reconstruct all four clause-status categories.
Neither $P=NP$ nor $P\ne NP$ is established.

\paragraph{LSPV-2 HAMMING-HUNTER251 (2026-10-30 06:12 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM TRANSFER / PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent referee pending.}
For original proper 3CNF source clauses, local all-literals-FALSE targets

forbidding pair intersections. Restricting assignments to one Hamming
layer $\Omega_r(a)$, exact source-local event counts are

source variables, $|E_j\cap E_k|=\binom{n-u}{r-h}$, where $u$ is the
union-support size and $h$ is the required flips relative to $a$.
Hunter's known spanning-tree union bound yields the \emph{SAT-only}
certificate
\[
H_T=\sum_j |E_j|-\sum_{\{j,k\}\in T}|E_j\cap E_k|
<\binom nr.
\]
A uniform deterministic conditional-expectation construction fixes
original-variable flip bits, charging both child tests, and verifies

A connected, distinct-clause strict exact-$(2+,2-)$ 3CNF with

The independent exhaustive oracle found $10$ witnesses at radius $3$

\paragraph{LSPV-2, POLICY-ENTRY-GATE253 (30 October 2026, 12:15 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted fixed-candidate theorem; independent review pending).}
For a specified set $B$ of original variables and each indexed clause
$C_j$, write $D_j=C_j\cap\mathrm{Lit}(B)$ and
$R_j=C_j\setminus D_j$. The source-preserving entry formula for
Horn is $\bigwedge_{j:\#\mathrm{pos}(R_j)>1}D_j$; dual-Horn uses
$\#\mathrm{neg}(R_j)>1$ and Krom uses $|R_j|>2$.
A coherent assignment $\beta$ to $B$ enters that class if and only if
it satisfies the associated entry formula. Such membership does not
decide SAT of the parent. At source width four Horn/dual-Horn entry is
2SAT, and at source width five Krom entry is 2SAT; one higher width
suffices to encode arbitrary proper 3SAT in this fixed-$B$ discovery
problem, even when every parent input is trivially SAT. This is a
policy-selection limitation only, not universal SAT hardness.
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} 67 SAT/UNSAT source controls (61/6),
37071 independent cofactor/class checks, 8 source-indexed implication
edges and 48 width-boundary control assignments passed. The
portfolio reduced ordinary DPLL nodes $311\to137$ but increased
selected Python work $5831\to15391$; failed policy recognition,
source scans and switches matter. These counters are not FLMV
same-machine resource bounds. The fully charged hereditary
arbitrary-decider $A\mapsto\Phi(A)$, physical ordinary-child

\paragraph{LSPV-2 PARITY-INDEXED-ACCESSOR268: a verified restricted child emitter and exact auxiliary-free parity guard cost (31 October 2026, 02:12 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM / PROVED/EXACT restricted (independent mathematical review pending).}
For source-authenticated original proper-3CNF, four-clause XOR chains with pairwise disjoint private variables and common boundary $B$, duplicate parity conditions may be deleted \emph{only} after complete indexed clause authentication. Keeping both contrary terminal pins yields a correctly UNSAT child. For every coherent boundary assignment $\beta$ the resulting ordinary-CNF child $G$ obeys
\[
\exists P\,F(\beta,P)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\exists Z\,G(\beta,Z).
\]
Every child SAT witness lifts to the signed original clauses; the same equivalence preserves source UNSAT with a typed parity/source truth-table certificate, not automatically a pure source-resolution proof. The constructed canonical DIMACS child has a checked exact symbol accessor using an explicit decimal-digit prefix formula, binary search over XOR gates and at most two chain descriptors, with $O(\log N)$ descriptor bits and charged $\mathrm{polylog}(N)$ local address arithmetic. This is \emph{not} the missing general CONSTRUCTION-STRENGTHEN17 strict22 bit accessor.

\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM (source representation-specific).}
An auxiliary-free CNF equivalent to even parity on $b$ boundary variables needs at least $2^{b-1}$ full-width clauses: a non-tautological entailed clause cannot omit any variable, and each full-width clause excludes exactly one odd assignment. Polynomial-size existential Tseitin encodings avoid this bound. It cannot be used as SAT hardness or as an ARC space lower bound.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL, fully qualified.}
The independent 26-formula original-clause audit (19 SAT, 7 UNSAT) passed 208,216 assertions, 37,504 small-source assignment slots, 36,820 original source-index pair extreme records, 3,296 boundary-profile checks, and 8,722 exact indexed character accesses. The canonical repetitive SAT source of 2,203,400 physical bits emitted a 1,016-bit ordinary child; the matched UNSAT source of 11,341,264 bits emitted a 1,984-bit child, both below $\sqrt N$, but \emph{only on the certified repetitive family}. Nine Horn/dual-Horn/2SAT/high-width/mixed controls (5 SAT, 4 UNSAT) used paid recognition and total fallback. Twelve matched small-source UP--DPLL controls searched 1,240 nodes, while the child searched the same 1,240, before extra scanning, validation, failed attempts, policy switching, output address arithmetic, and memory. The Python peak was 55,639,037 bytes and the guest consumed a materialized child. No total-work advantage or native FLMV space achievement follows.

\textbf{DUPLICATION / RECONCILIATION.}
This builds on existing LSPV-2 sparse-affine and source-authenticated mixed-interface theorems, with classical parity and knowledge-compilation techniques. The restricted affine MCSP small-bias no-go remains a scoped adversarial control. Untrusted arbitrary-CNF grouping discovery, universal source/project-join profile generation, heredity, physical CONSTRUCTION-STRENGTHEN17 indexed-bit access and the arbitrary-decider $A\mapsto\Phi(A)$ FLMV recurrence are \OPEN. Both $P=NP$ and $P\ne NP$ are \OPEN.
