\paragraph{LSPV-2, latest charged adaptive residual-SAT compiler ledger (31 October 2026, 05:35 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM / PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent mathematical review pending.}
A source-indexed \emph{private Krom projection} computes the actual boundary variable set from original higher-width source clauses, eliminates only the private width-two variables by fully authenticated Davis--Putnam resolution, and physically serializes an ordinary CNF child. For every boundary assignment $\beta$, the result satisfies
\[
G(\beta)=1\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \exists P\,F(\beta,P)=1.
\]
A source-indexed ordinary resolution DAG certifies every derived resolvent and original-source UNSAT refutation; reverse elimination plus an original-clause check reconstructs YES witnesses. Failed size gates and non-Krom residuals revert to an exact charged source solver, not a false negative. The proof avoids enumerating all boundary assignments, but quadratic-size clause tables and source/proof histories remain fully retained and paid. In the star family
$\bigwedge_i(\neg a_i\lor p)\land\bigwedge_j(\neg p\lor b_j)$,
eliminating $p$ produces $k^2$ distinct clauses $(\neg a_i\lor b_j)$, necessary for any auxiliary-free boundary-only equivalent 2-CNF. This is a representation-specific lower bound, not an arbitrary-SAT resource lower bound.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL.} The independent producer/checker tested 53 source formulas (31 SAT, 22 UNSAT), verified 511 original-source resolution steps and 1,700 exact boundary projections, audited 25,536 original-indexed four-way S/U clause extremes and coherent endpoint/flip controls, and rejected a deliberately corrupted resolution pivot. The aggregate controller paid 2,137,340 selected events versus 68,225 baseline, despite 119 versus 120 search nodes. Host-language event proxies and 10.8 MB Python peak allocation are \emph{not} native FLMV machine time/space.

\textbf{Prior compatible components.} LSPV-2 LAZY-INTERFACE-ACCESS269 exposed expensive repeated profile regeneration; CHECKPOINT-RANK-INDEX270 reduced repeated indexed child-profile evaluations with paid $2^b$ preprocessing and cached offsets; PREFIX-CERTIFIED-COVER271 gave a disjoint source-proved blocked/accepted boundary-cylinder projection but found a parity family where incomplete-prefix acceptance and child expansion invalidate naive cheap compression. All preserve the same-source SAT/UNSAT distinction and maintain source-indexed S/U extremes as adversarial controls, not the main research target. The new Krom compiler avoids $2^b$ profile enumeration for one restricted class, not for arbitrary CNF. Historical proofs and negative controls remain intact.

\textbf{OPEN.} No uniform all-input hereditary ordinary-SAT child emitter or arbitrary correct polynomial SAT decider $A\mapsto\Phi(A)$ has been built with all policy-discovery, switching, failed trials, source queries, physical output and guest indexed access, ancestor state and simultaneous peak writable space charged at the actual FLMV thresholds. \paragraph{LSPV-2 HORN-FRONTIER273 (31 October 2026, 06:12 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent mathematical referee pending; COMPUTATIONAL for executable controls.}
The original-source authenticated Horn chain \(R_k\), containing private
\(q_0,\ldots,q_k\) and boundary pairs \((a_i,b_i)\), has exact projected
boundary predicate
\[
  \exists q\,R_k
  \equiv \bigwedge_{\epsilon\in\{0,1\}^k}
           \left(\bigvee_{i=1}^k\neg t_{i,\epsilon_i}\right),
  \qquad t_{i,0}=a_i,\quad t_{i,1}=b_i.
\]
Every auxiliary-free boundary CNF equivalent to this projection, even
allowing arbitrary clause widths, needs at least \(2^k\) distinct clauses.
Each displayed clause has a \(k+1\)-step original-source resolution DAG.
The matched \(U_k=R_k\land\bigwedge_i(a_i\lor b_i)\) is UNSAT with a
\(3k+1\)-step original-source resolution refutation; \(R_k\) is SAT with
a checked original-source witness.  A computed index-addressed child
character accessor runs in \(O(k^2)\) arithmetic-word operations per query
without storing all child text, but physical output has
\(\Omega(k2^k)\) bits against an \(O(k\log k)\)-bit source.  Retaining
private variables or applying direct Horn forward chaining avoids this
representation-specific blowup; no unrestricted SAT runtime lower bound
follows.
The independent verification replayed 166 proof roots with 999 resolution
steps on 20 matched and renamed source instances (10 YES, 10 NO),
2,728 boundary assignments, 4,156 original signed-clause four-way
\(SS/SU/US/UU\) compatibility checks, and 20 rejected certificate

\paragraph{LSPV-2 HORN-KROM-FOREST-INTERFACE274 and TREEWIDTH-MINOR-GATE275 (31 October 2026, 07:12--08:12 PDT).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM / PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent mathematical review pending.}
For each source proper signed three-CNF clause
$C_j=(\ell_{j1}\lor\ell_{j2}\lor\ell_{j3})$, the prior
LSPV-2 forest-interface map makes private signed-occurrence variables
$y_{jk}$, negative Horn triples
$(\neg y_{j1}\lor\neg y_{j2}\lor\neg y_{j3})$ and Krom
links $(\ell_{jk}\lor y_{jk})\land(\neg\ell_{jk}\lor\neg y_{jk})$.
For every coherent source assignment $x$ the $y$ extension is
unique and $\exists y\,T(F)(x,y)\Leftrightarrow F(x)$.
The original clause has a three-step source-indexed resolution
derivation from the transformed clauses, permitting complete SAT-witness
lifting and original-source UNSAT-proof replay.  Although the Horn
component has primal treewidth at most $2$ and the Krom component is a
primal forest of width at most $1$, the \emph{full} interaction graph
obeys the new restricted exact bound
\[
  w=\operatorname{tw}(P(F))
  \ \le\ \operatorname{tw}(P(T(F)))
  \ \le\ \max\{w,5\}.
\]
The lower bound follows by contracting the occurrence link edges and
obtaining $P(F)$ as a minor.  The upper bound follows by attaching a
six-vertex leaf bag to any source tree-decomposition bag containing each
three-clause clique.  Thus for $w\ge5$ the full transformed width
equals source width, even though both constituents are independently
tractable.  This is a representation/compatibility gate, \emph{not} an
unconditional SAT complexity lower bound.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL.}
The standalone, independently checked 37 original SAT/UNSAT controls
(25/12) passed 71,787 explicit assertions, including 3,899 indexed
source SS/SU/US/UU pair modes, 1,283 source signed occurrences, 189
coherent single-flip transitions and 1,350 transformed-source proof
steps; four deliberate proof mutations were rejected. The paired
$K_7$-support SAT and UNSAT sources both have full graph width $6$,
versus separate Horn/Krom widths $2/1$.
For those matched sources, physically $N=21{,}712$-bit parents
produce ordinary $M=2{,}776$ and $2{,}872$-bit extracted children,
both failing $M\le\sqrt N$.  No input among the 37 met the proposed
power-short gate.  The controller computed exact small treewidth,
charged recognition, switches, source graph reads and full fallback;
Python host counters and retained memory are not native FLMV TM
bounds. The all-TRUE high-width SAT and locally refutable eight-clause
UNSAT controls show width is not a compulsory expense for every solver.

\paragraph{LSPV-3 SPECTRAL-PAIRED-COMPONENT-PEEL-GATE291 (31 October 2026, 22:24 PDT; restricted exact source-identification theorem, external referee pending).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted combinatorics, COMPUTATIONAL independently verified, ARC/FLMV and P versus NP OPEN.}
For any two \emph{valid aligned} duplicate-free proper D\"ocker Monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) sources, writing $V_F(x)$ for original violated-clause count and $p_F(T),q_F(T)$ for positive/negative signed occurrence of triple $T$, their complete violation functions have Walsh coefficients
\[
8V_F=m+\sum_{i<j}\left(\sum_{T\supset\{i,j\}}(p_F(T)+q_F(T))\right)z_iz_j
+\sum_{|T|=3}(p_F(T)-q_F(T))\prod_{i\in T}z_i.
\]
If $V_F=V_G$ pointwise, \emph{all changed source clauses are full incidence components consisting entirely of paired positive/negative triples}. Proof: unpaired triple cubic terms are immutable; exact quadratic pair-incidence balances require each removed paired triple at a vertex to be offset by two distinct added paired triples, exhausting the signed two-occurrence quotas and forcing every original incident clause to change. Recursively no changed vertex touches an unchanged source clause. In particular \emph{every connected canonical source containing an unpaired clause is uniquely identifiable from its full sparse Walsh coefficients}, but source identification is not SAT decision.
A deterministic sparse peeling procedure recovers unpaired triples directly from nonzero cubic coefficients, subtracts their pair contributions, and repeatedly resolves paired triples adjacent to residual quota-one vertices. It recovers every original component containing an unpaired clause using expected $O(n+m)$ source-RAM words/operations, or ordered maps $O((n+m)\log(n+m))$. Paired-only whole components can collide: classical Pasch $P^+\cup P^-$ and $Q^+\cup Q^-$ have identical pointwise $V$ and $18$ witnesses each. Six-variable exhaustive census covers all $5{,}625$ valid sources, finding $5{,}610$ profiles ($5{,}595$ singleton/$15$ paired-only doubleton), recovering all $5{,}550$ unpaired connected sources; a separately coded verifier passed $719{,}973$ checks. Inherited authenticated U198 UNSAT $3{,}666$-node modular refutation and V198 SAT $264$-clause full witness were independently rerun. On $31$ small SAT controls UP-first DPLL used $140$ nodes/$2{,}980$ literal probes; certified six-variable selection used zero DPLL nodes but $8{,}184$ extra literal slots and $2{,}480$ clause visits. Thus no fully charged speedup is established. Source reconstruction retains parent-scale writable words; aligned XOR is offline; native FLMV physical writable/index tapes, child bit access, guest calls and simultaneous peak space are unmeasured. \paragraph{LSPV-3 DIRECTIONAL-SWAP-CERT-GATE285 (31 October 2026, 16:24 PDT; restricted exact mathematics, independent peer review pending).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted directional certificate:} For a valid original D\"ocker duplicate-free proper Monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) source, coherent complete assignment $a$, and originally falsified positive/negative clauses, let $p=\rho_+(a)$ and $q=\rho_-(a)$ be their separate exact minimum hitting costs. Because each variable occurs twice per sign, $p$ and $q$ are computable by the previously proved Gallai matching-cover construction. For \emph{every} satisfying $b$, with $\Delta=|b|-|a|$, the source-name-correct lower bound is
\[
d_H(a,b)\ge p+q+|\Delta-(p-q)|.
\]
For a fixed-weight Hamming slice, each move exchanging a zero and a one costs one, and $h(a)=\max(p,q)$ is an admissible \emph{consistent} A* heuristic: one exchange changes each $\rho_\pm$ by at most one. The result is a specialized optional search policy, \emph{not} an all-input polynomial algorithm or a mandatory resource for arbitrary deciders. Its no-import verifier checked 4,736 exhaustive small-source assignments, 1,109,376 directed source-witness inequalities, 145,344 one-swap consistency relations, 606 independently enumerated SS/SU/US/UU original-clause modes, 1,716 signed original occurrence S/U/inversion targets, 858 complete flip-trail steps, 24 BFS/A* fixed-slice verdicts and 30 malformed-input rejections, totaling 1,267,478 counted checks. The source-certified U198 UNSAT (six independently checked modules and 64 boundary assignments, 3,666 proof nodes) and V198 SAT (198-variable original-source witness) have identical directional endpoint and checkerboard signatures; negative fixed-weight slices cannot establish UNSAT. On SAT CUBE12, anchor 27 of weight four has $(p,q)=(2,0)$ and nearest same-slice model distance exactly two swaps; the directional bound improves on $\lceil(p+q)/2\rceil=1$. CUBE12 weight-four BFS expands 76 states using 3,648 literal probes; matching A* expands 14 but uses 17,376 literal probes and 348 matching calls, so node reductions \emph{do not} imply charged savings. Previously verified GATE244/284 matching repair, GATE283/REFEREE251 logical XOR accounting, and LSPV-4 M22 component closure are explicitly credited and preserved. \[

\]
Thus exact minimum strong-Krom backdoor acquisition is NP-complete \emph{even on trivial all-positive dual-Horn SAT instances}. This restart principle was already established in ADAPTIVE-SELECTOR-GATE255 and LSPV-1 ARC-SPACE-CAPPED-DOVETAIL262; no novelty is claimed. \textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted, external review pending}: on an easy authenticated proper-3CNF SAT/UNSAT pair a prior silent policy can allocate $\Omega(N)$ work-tape bits before a later $O(N)$-time, $O(\log N)$-space winning source recognizer, despite $O(N)$ serial portfolio time. Winner-only space does not upper-bound the actual peak; capping every trial requires separate successful-policy coverage. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL}: the independent checker passed 145,101 counted assertions across 19 original sources (12 SAT, 7 UNSAT), 131,816 full assignment evaluations, 6,704 source-clause four-mode extreme checks, 329 original-source DPLL proof nodes and five corrupted-certificate rejections. Actual six-policy fully charged selected work was 323,553 events against 74,434 ascending UP-DPLL events, with 713 unsuccessful bounded trials. These are Python-host counters, not native FLMV indexed-machine instructions or workspace. Source-local $S/U$ occurrence inversions, coherent endpoints, complement and Gray-flip trails remain hostile controls, not SAT or UNSAT oracles. The portfolio emits zero ordinary SAT children, uses zero arbitrary-decider guest calls and provides \emph{no} all-input hereditary ARC contraction; $P=NP$ and $P\ne NP$ remain \OPEN.

\paragraph{LSPV-3 HORN-AFFINE-MIXED-GATE274 (31 October 2026, 05:29 PDT; independent mathematical review pending).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM TRANSFER / PROVED/EXACT restricted / COMPUTATIONAL.}
A direct signed-occurrence reduction takes any proper 3CNF source $F$ with
$n$ variables and $m$ clauses to a single proper 3CNF $T(F)$ with
$n+6m$ variables and $13m$ original clauses.  It is the conjunction
of an individually satisfiable negative-ternary Horn component $H$
and an individually satisfiable affine/XOR component $E$, with
$\exists y,t\, T(F)(x,y,t)\Longleftrightarrow F(x)$ for every coherent
source assignment $x$, and
$\#\mathrm{SAT}(T(F))=2^{3m}\#\mathrm{SAT}(F)$.
Therefore identifying a jointly feasible assignment from separately
successful Horn and affine component solvers is NP-complete on this
authenticated image unless P=NP.  This is an explicit incarnation
of Schaefer's known constraint-language boundary, not a new
unconditional lower bound for arbitrary machines.
The independent finite checker passed eleven same-source cases
(eight SAT, three UNSAT), including W1/SWAP6 signed22 and renamed
controls, complete original-source endpoint/complement/Gray and
$SS,SU,US,UU$ adversarial matrices, and resolution proofs for source
UNSAT.  In small controls, full mixed DPLL took 117/207 nodes versus
six/seven on the recovered ordinary source children; no full
mixed baseline was measured on larger sources.  The child is merely
linear-size, descendants are not closed, and no same-machine FLMV
resource recurrence is obtained.  \textbf{OPEN:} universal all-input
both-label hereditary arbitrary-$A\mapsto\Phi(A)$ with charged
discovery, failed trials, output, access and simultaneous workspace.
P versus NP remains \OPEN.

\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted fixed-module control).}

\textbf{ONEBIT-POLARITY-CERT152 (PROVED/EXACT lift; proof discovery OPEN;
marker-safe retry pending).}
For every proper source clause $(a_i\lor b_i\lor c_i)$, the two-clause lift
$(\neg z\lor a_i\lor t_i)\land(\neg t_i\lor b_i\lor c_i)$ has exact
existential projection $\neg z\lor\exists X F$.  Thus the exposed boundary
relation has only the values $\mathsf{TOP}$ and $\neg z$.  Verifying a bare
$\mathsf{TOP}$ entry is NP-complete and verifying a bare $\neg z$ entry is
coNP-complete under the source-authentication interpretation; a complete
branch-to-2CNF UNSAT proof exists but is exponential.  The 71,137-assertion
reproducer, including the 8,192-leaf W1 control, was independently rerun.
The current GitHub report lacks both mandatory ownership markers and awaits an
owner-preserved marker-only retry.  A small table is not a polynomial proof
generator or arbitrary-SAT child constructor.

For connected components, a hypothetical uniform polynomial exact-table

polynomial Turing reduction; connected prescribed-fiber many-one hardness is

\paragraph{LSPV-3, CONTEXT-VALUE-AFFINE171 (29 October 2026, 18:24 PDT; restricted affine information-value theorem, external referee pending).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted):} In the detached reusable-summary model for
$A_{\alpha,\beta}(X):\langle\alpha,X\rangle=\beta$ and all later pin contexts,
any fixed-length summary has $L\ge b+1$ bits; storing the original affine row
attains equality with polynomial preparation and continuation. Matrix-graph
affine sources $z=Mu$ with $b=2h$ require $L\ge h^2$, also attained up to
lower-order encoding overhead by retaining $M$. These are offline-all-context
information bounds, \emph{not} time lower bounds for a joint solver seeing
$A,B$, and not exponential in encoded source size.
\textbf{FALSIFIED/RETIRED (restricted greedy policy):} A target-specific
marginal-entropy policy fails on the two XOR shares $\alpha_i,\beta$ for
context $X=e_i$: each alone has zero target information, while the pair
determines the SAT answer. Positive-marginal-only greed can choose an
arbitrarily costly exact direct-answer macro over two one-bit source probes.
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (conditional ledger):} If complete-state integer rank
starts below $P$, has total upward drift at most $G$, and fully charged
intervals between strict decreases each cost at most $C$, then same-run
total time is at most $(P+G+1)C$. Pure affine $A(X,Y)$ with affine
continuation $B(X,Z)$ has a uniform Gaussian projected-summary controller,
verified SAT witness reconstruction and original-row XOR UNSAT certificates,
with conservative polynomial bit-time and space. No all-SAT acquisition
result follows; $P=NP$ and $P\ne NP$ remain \OPEN.

\paragraph{LSPV-3 PARITY-POLICY-SYNDROME173 (29 October 2026, 19:27 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted pre-materialized indexed parity-bit probe model; independent review pending).}
For a public menu of raw coordinate and pre-materialized triple-parity probes, an exact deterministic adaptive controller must on every successful path query rows spanning target $t$ over $\mathbb F_2$. Thus optimal worst-case \emph{data-probe count} equals the minimum number of available rows whose XOR is $t$. An independently defined uncovered-target-support potential has a necessary zero terminal value and decreases by at most three per charged primitive probe, giving $P_{\rm data}+Q_{\rm data}\ge\lceil|\operatorname{supp}(t)|/3\rceil$ within this limited menu. Finding whether an all-ones target on $3q$ coordinates admits a $q$-probe policy is NP-complete by the classical X3C incidence reduction, despite legal raw-coordinate reads. A disjoint-triple promise has a uniformly polynomial optimal planner with exact cost $\sum_j\min(k_j,4-k_j)$, handling both answer labels. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} 640 X3C metadata controls, 770 exhaustive adaptive comparisons and 4680 disjoint target masks passed. Raw JSON SHA256 \texttt{b2a4335ea0f49805772238dcdd33ff4fe62c1d19ddee0dad226d4c6066e76b96}. Original-source retention, paid parity materialization, XOR synergy, duplicate redundancy, score/discovery work, failed policies and physical machine distinctions remain explicit. \paragraph{LSPV-3, LAMINAR-PARITY-POLICY174 (29 October 2026, 19:54 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted laminar indexed-parity-source model; independent referee pending).}
For a public laminar family of materialized XOR masks containing all coordinate
probes, with positive weights and public target $t$, a uniform deterministic
controller recognizes the laminar input, computes an exact optimal weighted
probe plan, reconstructs its queried-mask XOR certificate, and returns the
correct target parity on both answer labels.  The two-state inclusion-tree
recurrence
\[
D_i(a)=w_i(a\oplus t_i),\qquad
D_u(a)=\min_{z\in\{0,1\}}
\bigl\{zw_u+\sum_{v\in\mathrm{child}(u)}D_v(a\oplus z)\bigr\}
\]
takes $z=0$ when the root or an internal node is a synthetic unavailable
probe.  The minimum cost is $D_{\mathrm{root}}(0)$; every adaptive exact
transcript must span the target row, so data-dependent adaptation cannot
improve this declared weighted source-probe price.  This is a non-disjoint,
nested extension of the disjoint-triple policy in SYNDROME173, not a
general-SAT theorem or an unrestricted optimal-policy discovery algorithm.
The full cost charges laminar recognition $O(M^2m)$, DP/traceback, each
source probe at weight $w_S$, paid view construction if not previously
materialized, certificate verification, and actual peak workspace.  For
$w_{\max}\le N^c$ the one-controller same-run indexed-RAM time and space
are polynomial.  A nonlaminar menu falls back to charged original-coordinate
reads, without claiming optimality.

\textbf{FALSIFIED/RETIRED (restricted heuristic):}
On a four-bit laminar instance, the two complementary XOR halves each have
zero initial contextual target-information value but jointly reveal the
target; a strictly positive-singleton-gain greedy policy may choose a direct
probe of price $K$ instead of the two halves of total price 2.  The
competitive ratio $K/2$ is unbounded as allowed weights grow.
The notation $p_S\mid_{v_{\Phi}}$ denotes a state-dependent score, not
probability conditioning or intrinsic datum value; discovery and acquisition
remain charged.  The prior WEIGHTED-SUMMARY-SCHEDULER170 peak-table
memory-order theorem remains a distinct valid no-recomputation baseline.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} A seed-1741029 independent Dijkstra oracle matched
the DP on 7,584 target masks across 144 generated weighted laminar families,
$m=2,\ldots,8$; 463 exact source-answer reconstructions matched, with
both possible answers observed.  Raw JSON SHA-256
\texttt{d36248f1cea3e44dc31e523481666ed3ee82c0ee36448e7f9bcc0f0a83378852}.
The source-retention, affine/Tseitin, joint-input solver and one-tape
transport controls remain easy; the model gives no arbitrary-SAT lower bound.

\paragraph{LSPV-3, BATCH-LAMINAR-POLICY175 (29 October 2026, 20:27 PDT; restricted theorem, independent referee pending).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted, peer review pending):} For a publicly supplied laminar family of positively priced physically materialized XOR-source masks containing all singletons, a single deterministic polynomial-time controller computes the \emph{exact minimum total paid source-probe price} for an arbitrary batch of $k$ requested parity targets, among \emph{all} deterministic answer-dependent adaptive controllers using that fixed source-view menu.  Write each coordinate's batch signature as $c_i=W_{*,i}\in\mathbb F_2^k$, and let $\mathcal C=\{0,c_1,\ldots,c_m\}$, of size $\le m+1$ regardless of $k$.  On the laminar inclusion tree, an optimal label assignment exists entirely inside $\mathcal C$: simultaneously replacing every unpinned label outside $\mathcal C$ by $0$ never increases the positively weighted number of unequal-label edges.  Its exact tree recurrence is
\[
 D_u(a)=\min_{b\in\mathcal C}
 \left(\sum_{v\in\mathrm{child}(u)}D_v(b)+w_u\mathbf 1[b\ne a]\right),
 \qquad D_{\{i\}}(a)=w_i\mathbf1[a\ne c_i],
\]
with unavailable synthetic full-root mask pinned to label $0$.  The extracted mask set's coefficient XOR is explicitly checked against all target rows.  At each successful deterministic adaptive transcript, the queried mask span must contain the entire target row space, since otherwise a source perturbation in its orthogonal complement changes one required answer while preserving the observed transcript.  This gives a full per-source optimum price, not a SAT lower bound.

Define the independent certified contextual \emph{information-value rank} $\Phi_W(s)=\operatorname{rank}(W)-\dim(\operatorname{rowspan}(W)\cap V(s))$; marginal scores $p_S\mid_{v_\Phi}$ are $0$ or $1$, may exhibit XOR synergy, and do \emph{not} pay for useful zero-initial-value shares.  The \emph{charged execution account} $\Omega(s)=\sum_{S\in J\ {\rm unread}}w_S$ telescopes along the reconstructed fixed optimum plan; recognition, score discovery, failed nonlaminar recognition, DP, source access, verification, caching, output reconstruction, writable state and peak memory receive additional explicit polynomial charges.  The unrestricted formula-retention control remains legal.  \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} the complete local seeded test suite compared 240 laminar instances against 80,000 exhaustive source-mask subsets and checked 720 source/batch answers, plus a 64-variable, 128-target batch using $\le65$ labels.  Full standalone LaTeX report and a separately source-verified GitHub compact reproducer and raw seed summary are at

\textbf{OCCURRENCE-LAZY-MERGE176 (PROVED/EXACT restricted; independent referee pending).}
For every proper width-$k$ source CNF with $m$ clauses and $n$ variables,
a source-parent-authenticated streaming controller reproduces exactly the
full unit-propagation closure of \emph{all first-generation} non-tautological
opposite-occurrence resolvents, without persistently storing them.
Writing $P=\sum_xd_x^+d_x^-$, the charged indexed-RAM bounds per partial
prefix are $T=O(N+(n+1)^2mk+(n+1)Pk^2)$ and
$S=O(N+(mk+nk)\log N)$ bits, including index rebuilds, failed scans,
restarts of source UP and proof records. This is not a bound on the whole
adaptive SAT branch DAG. The connected proper width-three grid
$G_{r,s}=\bigwedge_i(x\vee a\vee u_i)\land
\bigwedge_j(\neg x\vee a\vee v_j)$ has $rs$ \emph{distinct}
non-tautological merge resolvents with additive forbidden-cube weight
$rs/8$ but exact union density
$\tfrac12(1-2^{-r})(1-2^{-s})<\tfrac12$.
Its source clause equity is exactly $Q_{\rm positive}=2^s$ and
$Q_{\rm negative}=2^r$. At the all-$u,v$-false partial prefix
one resolution infers $a=1$ while source-UP alone cannot;
full assignment union already excluded by source clauses gives zero
marginal learned-clause gain.
This falsifies additive scores \emph{even after deduplicating resolvents},
and demonstrates that a useful contextual forced-variable gain must be
charged separately from discovery and source access.
The grid is \emph{not} strict signed exact-$(2,2)$, and its obvious
$a=1$ witness is a required easy control.
Independent script checks: 4063 eager/lazy partial-prefix outcomes,
720 complement identities, and eight grid controls, plus SAT/UNSAT,
Horn, 2SAT and XOR cases; selected-work and peak-space measurements
are COMPUTATIONAL, not universal lower bounds.

\paragraph{LSPV-3, PAIRED-EXTREME-CONTROLLER241 (29 October 2026, 22:28 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT (restricted paired-pivot 2CNF elimination, independent
referee pending); COMPUTATIONAL (finite hostile controls).}
Following the user's active clause-indexed $S/U$ extreme-inversion direction
(issue \#3), for every signed original occurrence $x_{i,j}$ with negative
bit $\nu_{ij}$, local all-literals-SAT requires $a_i=1\oplus\nu_{ij}$
and local all-literals-UNSAT requires $a_i=\nu_{ij}$; inversion swaps them.
For shared original clauses, $SS=UU$ is feasible iff there is no
opposite-sign shared variable and $SU=US$ is feasible iff there is no
same-sign shared variable. Incompatibility of all four extreme modes does
\emph{not} imply ordinary disjunctive formula UNSAT.
For an arbitrary proper binary source $G=\bigwedge_jD_j$ and fresh
private pivots $p_j$, the source-authenticated proper ternary construction
$F_G=\bigwedge_j[(D_j\vee p_j)\wedge(D_j\vee\neg p_j)]$
is identically equivalent to $G$; each paired source pivot resolves
to $D_j$ and forbids the entire partial cube falsifying $D_j$.
A deterministic fully charged paired recognizer and known 2SAT SCC solver
decides this restricted class polynomially. A deliberately pivot-first,
nonlearning UP-DPLL on the stated UNSAT paired controls visits exactly
$2^{M+2}-1$ recursion states, versus a \emph{core-first} DPLL with just
7 states on identical formulas: no generic DPLL or SAT lower bound follows.
On a paired SAT family fixed reflected Gray scanning takes $2^M+1$
full candidates, while one authenticated first-clause repair flip finds
a SAT witness, although the \emph{complete controller overhead can exceed}
UP-DPLL. Across 15 paired and 15 adverse controls 16{,}824 exact pair-mode
checks and 2{,}352 multi-clause checks passed; paired UNSAT $M=14$ used
65{,}535 pivot-first DPLL nodes/4{,}439{,}948 selected work against
10{,}236 controller work, whereas paired SAT $M=12$ cost 5{,}389 controller
versus 1{,}430 DPLL selected work. Strict signed exact-$(2,2)$ W1 UNSAT
also had controller overhead; this class is not the proven paired class.
Work counts are an instrumented proxy, not exact machine steps or CDCL.

\textbf{SIGNED-NAE-EULER247 (30 October, 04:51 PDT): PROVED/EXACT,
restricted; independent mathematical referee pending.}
For a proper signed 3CNF consisting of pairs $(D_j,\overline D_j)$
and with every original variable occurring in exactly two distinct
base clauses, a deterministic signed Euler-trail construction produces
and source-verifies a full SAT assignment.  Its original-variable dual
multigraph has degree three at clause vertices; adding a hub edge per
vertex gives an Eulerian even graph.  Removing hub edges yields variable
trails.  Assign successive variable bits so two paired signed literal
truths at each base clause are opposite.  Every base clause and
complement then have one TRUE and one FALSE literal.
The fully charged recognizer, adjacency and Euler construction,
assignment, source reads, and final witness replay take
$O(M+n)$ indexed word-RAM work and words with normalized integer IDs
and stable bounded-key radix sorting (or $O(M\log M)$ comparison sorting).
No hidden SAT answer or witness is supplied.  The statement covers
signed frustrated incidences but not arbitrary strict exact-$(2,2)$ CNF.
The known monotone NAE special case is not claimed as novel.

\textbf{PROVED/EXACT complement-invariant extension; FALSIFIED/RETIRED
fixed two-witness policy.}
For SAT complement-invariant $H$, any one nonempty added clause $C$
remains satisfiable by choosing a witness of $H$ or its full complement.
Two added clauses can reject a particular chosen witness/complement pair
even while the extended formula is SAT (explicit paired $K_4$ control).
This does not establish UNSAT or solve the general case.

\COMPUTATIONAL\ 13 clause-indexed SAT/UNSAT hostile controls and all

checks.  Checks include original-occurrence local $S_j/U_j$ targets,

\subsection*{LSPV-3 exact acquisition countercontrol: TSEITIN-SELECTOR-GATE255 (2026-10-30 11:29)}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted canonical-source theorem, independent review pending.}
For every connected simple cubic graph with $v$ vertices and an arbitrary vector of charge bits $b$, the exact four-clause-per-vertex 3CNF Tseitin source has SAT iff $\bigoplus_t b_t=0$; every proper subset of complete charge blocks is SAT; the same condition equals even $N_0(0^e)$ \emph{only after an exact source XOR-grammar verification}. A deterministic exact decider for this canonical fixed-graph promise must inspect one charge-dependent source bit in every one of its $v=\Omega(N/\log N)$ source blocks on every input, by a one-charge-flip indistinguishability adversary. The input-read bound is tight and does not force high workspace, arbitrary SAT runtime or mandatory per-child re-reading: a shared one-bit parity summary suffices for repeated decision queries. Under the expressly \emph{no-sharing} architecture in which each of $N^{3/5}$ child operations must separately decide complete global parity, accumulated parent source probes are $N^{8/5-o(1)}$, outside the proposed FLMV $c=241/200$ box. That is a \emph{restricted architecture falsifier}, not an ARC obstruction for arbitrary children. The family is signed exact-$(4+,4-)$, not strict22.
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} one uniform charged Krom/Horn/dual-Horn/XOR-certified/fallback DPLL controller passed both SAT and UNSAT cases, 10,872 proper-subset rank tests, 64 exhaustively enumerated small charge vectors, 384 single-charge toggle controls, 32 polarity-and-variable renamings, and 240 random mixed-CNF truth-table controls. On odd-charge six-vertex source, 400 selected controller events versus 3,137 ordinary DPLL events; no CDCL or FLMV-machine measurement is claimed. Original signed22 W1 UNSAT and SWAP6 SAT both have $N_0(0^{15})=1$, \textbf{falsifying} unguarded endpoint parity; their source does not match the cubic XOR grammar and falls back. Source-query acquisition, recognition storage and witness reconstruction are charged; this implementation has $O(N)$ writable indexing and does \emph{not} achieve the proposed ARC space bound.
\textbf{OPEN:} hereditary all-input arbitrary-$A$ SAT-to-ordinary-SAT power-shrinking compiler with fully charged source access and simultaneous FLMV time/space. \paragraph{LSPV-3 SAT-ONLY-SELECTOR-FIREWALL256 (30 October 2026, 12:24 PDT; independent review pending).}
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM, elementary self-reducibility.}
A uniform polynomial-time total selector that, on every ordinary SAT
residual, chooses at least one consistent original-variable assignment
preserving SAT whenever the source is SAT (with no selection promise on
UNSAT inputs) exists exactly if SAT is in P. Iterating the selector and
checking the complete original-source assignment gives a total both-label
polynomial decider; conversely a polynomial SAT decider can test the
zero cofactor before choosing the safe side. This does \emph{not}
supply a selector or show P=NP.
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted architecture, review pending.}
A purported arbitrary-$A$ ARC stage that invokes a correct guest
polynomial SAT decider $A$ on a direct cofactor of physical size
$\Theta(N)$ cannot uniformly meet
$K'\le\max\{\alpha,\gamma+\lambda K\}$ for all polynomial guest
exponents $K$ when $\lambda<1$: legal DELAY wrappers of the
guest incur $\Theta(N^K)$ on this full-parent call. This rules out
that particular parent-sized guest policy, not arbitrary adaptive
source-aware choices. The strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ direct
one-pin cofactor retains at least $m-4$ untouched source clauses,
as already proved by LSPV-2 COFACTOR-VOLUME-ARC252.
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} independent exhaustive checks of all 256
proper signed three-variable clause subsets validate the safe-selector
logic; 15 SAT cases invalidate blind first-zero selection. Authentic
strict22 W1 (UNSAT) and SWAP6 (SAT, 54 models), signed renamings,
Horn, Krom, XOR, and original-clause $S/U$ extremal controls were
tested. Same-engine selected work on W1 was 15,451 standard DPLL
versus 14,343 charged guest-selector events; on SWAP6 it was 7,518
versus 15,575, with full source access and guest outputs paid.
These are not native FLMV time--space measurements.

\paragraph{LSPV-3 ARC-SIGNED-OVERLAP-CHILD-GATE258 (2026-10-30).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted direct-cofactor original-source accounting; independent review pending.}
For a proper strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ 3CNF, a coherent partial assignment of $t$ variables has exactly $2t$ assigned-TRUE source occurrences. Writing $s_j$ for their multiplicity in original clause $C_j$, $D=\#\{j:s_j>0\}$ for deleted clauses, and $\Omega=\sum_j(s_j-1)_+$ for repeated coverage, one has the exact state-dependent identity
$D=2t-\Omega$.  A further pin $x=b$ changes the deleted-clause count by $2-h_x(b;\rho)$, where $h_x$ counts the already deleted source clauses among the two satisfying occurrences of $x=b$; both updates use authenticated original occurrences and must charge acquisition.  Combining the previously verified LSPV-4 signed22 $D\le2t$ bound with the previously verified LSPV-1 explicit prefix-cylinder Kraft theorem gives a physically serialized direct-cofactor child-size requirement and corresponding source-certified NO-cube mass bound. This is \emph{not} a lower bound on arbitrary SAT algorithms, semantic compilers, or cached DAGs.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL, exact-source finite controls.}
On the $15$-variable W1 UNSAT/SWAP6 SAT signed22 twins (20 clauses, 349-bit declared source encoding, 18-bit child cap, 33-guest cap), a source-conflict-aware degree policy produced a complete W1 refutation with $413$ original-clause NO cubes and no guest, and produced $16$ verified short ordinary SAT residual children for SWAP6, with $412$ source-NO cubes. The alternate first-variable SWAP6 policy yielded $36>33$ children. A family of easy connected strict22 formulas with a polynomial-time source-known witness remains a hostile counterexample to treating large direct-cofactor guest counts as SAT hardness. Independent finite checker passed 184,300 checks; original $S/U$ occurrence targets, source-indexed four-mode pair matrices, coherent endpoints and partial flips remain adversarial controls. \paragraph{LSPV-3 source-frontier recursive replay (RECURSIVE-FRONTIER-REPLAY260).}
\textbf{KNOWN METHOD SPECIALIZATION, exact restricted proof, independent review pending.}
For the source-authenticated original-clause order, let $B_i$ be the prefix/suffix shared variables, $U_i=B_{i-1}\cup{\rm Var}(C_i)$, and $w=\max_i|U_i|$.
The previously established exact Boolean forward/reverse frontier-support identities admit a Hirschberg-style divide-and-conquer replay: on interval $(a,b]$, compute global midpoint prefix and suffix messages and recurse on both sides. At each singleton join the original clause with its actual global boundary messages; this emits exactly all $H_i(u)$, so unsupported original-source local patterns are formally forbidden partial cubes for SAT and UNSAT instances alike. A \emph{streaming} implementation retains $O(2^w(w+\log N)\log(m+1)+S_B+\log^2(N+2))$ simultaneous writable bits while paying $O(N+\log(m+1)\sum_i[d_{i-1}+d_i+2^{|U_i|}{\rm poly}(|U_i|+k+\log N)]+mk2^k)$ indexed-word time; here $d_i$ and $S_B$ explicitly charge source-boundary discovery and access, and every streamed output symbol is billed. Retaining all output in RAM removes the low-space claim. The recognizer for the numeric source-band grammar $|v-i|\le b$ charges the initial source scan and $O(b^2k)$ source-occurrence work per boundary, but low numeric band is not invariant under variable renaming and not arbitrary hardness.

\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL, adverse fully charged same-source controls.}
Independent full-table/global-mask replay and small exhaustive source-oracle checks agree on 23 original formulas and 9,958 checked records, with two corrupted outputs rejected. W1 strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ is UNSAT and SWAP6 is SAT with 54 models; SWAP6 has 70 globally unsupported local patterns of 160. Band128 SAT/UNSAT recursive replay uses 1,917,887/1,915,434 selected host operations versus full DP 839,166/837,844 and UP-first DPLL 61,057/17,566. W1/SWAP6 replay uses 1,604,689/1,602,849 versus DPLL 19,962/9,548. Band128 SAT replay has a conservative 111 live-table-entry envelope versus 2,115 full retained entries, but W1's loose replay envelope is \emph{worse} than retaining its tables. Original clause-indexed signed $S/U$ targets, inversions, extreme compatibility and coherent complement flips were checked as adverse controls, not used as semantic oracle decisions. These instrumented events are not native FLMV machine costs. \paragraph{LSPV-3 ARC-BRANCH-MASS-GATE261 (30 October 2026, 17:35 PDT; restricted theorem, independent review pending).}

For strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ source $F$ on $n$ variables with $m=4n/3$ original clauses, a partial assignment fixing $t$ variables eliminates exactly $D=2t-\Omega$ clauses, where $\Omega=\sum_j\max(0,s_j-1)$ and $s_j$ counts fixed TRUE literals in the original $C_j$. In a complete binary source-authenticated cofactor partition with rejected cubes $P$, fully satisfied leaves $S$ and exact residual children $E$ containing at most $r$ original clauses, $t_*=\lceil(m-r)/2\rceil$ and
\[
\sum_{P}2^{-|\rho|}+\sum_{S}2^{-|\rho|}
+\sum_{E}2^{-|\rho|}=1,\qquad
\sum_{P}2^{-|\rho|}+\sum_{S}2^{-|\rho|}\geq1-|E|2^{-t_*}.
\]
Every inferred unit is paired with its \emph{source-justified} contradictory binary sibling, rather than charged as a free disappearance of assignment mass. This is a combination of the classical binary-tree Kraft equality and earlier signed-overlap accounting, not a novel SAT lower bound. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL:} same-source W1 UNSAT and SWAP6 SAT (0 and 54 models) satisfy the independently replayed coverage; at the 8-original-clause cutoff, max-occurrence selection gives respectively 3 and 11 physical residual children, but their encodings remain 86--117 bits versus the proposed 19-bit child limit. \noindent\textbf{LSPV-3 HORN-GUARD-SET-COVER-GATE268 (31 October 2026, 00:24 PDT; PROVED/EXACT restricted; independent mathematical review pending; COMPUTATIONAL both-label checks).}
For an explicitly source-indexed definite Horn CNF $H$ of width at most three,

\paragraph{LSPV-3 STRICT22-BACKDOOR-SELECTOR-GATE271 (31 October 2026, 02:19 PDT; restricted exact theorem, external referee pending).}
For a proper original CNF, a static \emph{strong syntactic} Krom,
Horn, or dual-Horn backdoor $B$ is characterized, respectively, by
$|B\cap\operatorname{var}(C)|\ge |C|-2$,
$|B\cap\operatorname{pos}(C)|\ge |\operatorname{pos}(C)|-1$,
or its negative-literal analogue for every original clause $C$.
For proper strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$-3CNF, each of the three minimum
backdoor sizes is at least $\lceil n/3\rceil$. On the previously
constructed connected orbit family with $n=3k$ (odd $k\ge7$), their
\emph{exact} sizes are $(k,2k,2k)$, even though a fixed canonical
original-source grammar is checkable in $O(N\operatorname{polylog}N)$
time, $O(\log N)$ auxiliary space and yields a verified SAT witness.
The signed-renamed orbit remains polynomial-time recognizable by the
prior bounded-degree graph-isomorphism result, with no small-space claim.
Thus large static strong-backdoor size is \emph{not} a lower bound on
arbitrary adaptive SAT solvers or on depth backdoors.

An architecture explicitly emitting every static cofactor needs at least
$2^{n/3}$ children, whereas retaining a literal four-mode original
SS/SU/US/UU record for every pair costs $2m(m-1)$ simultaneous bits.
Both are \emph{architecture-conditional} barriers; source-local streaming,
inference caching, different policy acquisition, and early witnesses
remain permitted and must be charged. A nineteen-source independent
finite verifier checked 16,908 clause-pair modes, 978 signed occurrence
extremes, 132,660 coherent exhaustive assignments, 83,781 smaller

\paragraph{LSPV-3 M22-BIPARTITE-FACTOR-GATE280 (31 October 2026, 11:24 PDT; PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent mathematical review pending; COMPUTATIONAL same-source controls).}

\paragraph{LSPV-3 GATE282: globally extendible danger, restricted SAT certificate (2026-10-31 13:24 PDT).}
On every valid duplicate-free proper monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) source, call a negative triple dangerous if its three positive cubic-dual edge labels are pairwise vertex-disjoint. A dangerous triple is \emph{extendible} iff deletion of its six endpoints leaves a perfect matching. Let $q_{\rm ext}$ count extendible dangerous original clauses. \textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted, external review pending:} if the positive cubic dual is bridgeless and $q_{\rm ext}\le2$, one polynomially discovered perfect matching avoids a chosen edge from each extendible danger by Edmonds' uniform $1/3$ edge-marginal decomposition, yielding a complete original-clause-verified SAT witness. Sign reversal gives the negative-dual counterpart. Excluding nonextendible triples sharpens prior GATE281 $q\le2$ and the independent LSPV-1 H22-DANGEROUS-HITSET282 $\tau\le2$ theorem. A valid 12-variable cube source has $q=3$, pairwise-disjoint dangerous triples $\tau=3$, but $q_{\rm ext}=2$; its TRUE set $\{1,7,8,9\}$ satisfies all 16 source clauses (268 models, exhaustively checked). The exact matching-witness decision cost is at most $q+3^{q_{\rm ext}}$ general perfect-matching calls, not an arbitrary-SAT complexity lower bound. An independent checker tested 15 valid sources including a source-refuted 198-variable UNSAT control, 143336 original clause-pair compatibility modes, and 10 malformed strings. Full source graph and repeated matching calls are charged; 4 matching calls on the strict example exceeded an eight-node tiny DPLL baseline in overhead. No hereditary in-target ordinary SAT children, low-space FLMV transfer, or arbitrary-$A\mapsto\Phi(A)$ contraction follows. \textbf{P versus NP OPEN.} Report: \path{research/agents/lspv-3/2026-10-31_1324_LSPV-3_EXTENDIBLE_DANGER_SELECTOR_GATE282.tex}; compact reproducer \path{experiments/arc/lspv3_282/strict282.py}; independently checked archive preserved with a documented full-data Library container-session failure.

\paragraph{LSPV-3 GATE284 CONSISTENT-MATCHING-RADIUS (31 October 2026, 15:24 PDT; elementary exact theorem, independent mathematical review pending).}
For every CNF source, let $\rho_F(a)$ be the minimum number of original source variables required to hit all original clauses false at complete anchor $a$. Every SAT witness $b$ satisfies $\rho_F(a)\le d_H(a,b)$, and any single coordinate flip obeys $|\rho_F(a)-\rho_F(a\oplus e_i)|\le1$, because any newly false source clause contains the flipped variable. This makes $\rho$ an admissible and consistent one-bit-move lower bound but does not imply polynomial global decision. On canonical duplicate-free proper monotone exact-(2,2), its polynomial computation as $\rho=|U|-\nu(G_U)$ by maximum matching is \emph{KNOWN} from Gallai and previously proved in LSPV-3 GATE244; no priority claim is made. For Hamming ball radius $R$ and partial prefix with $h$ changed reference variables, $h+\rho_{\rm free}>R$ is a sound certificate that no SAT witness in that \emph{ball} completes the prefix, not an UNSAT proof. Finite independent verification checked 4,736 complete small-source assignments, 24 radius-constrained decisions, 706 independent brute-force cover minima, 5,976 one-bit consistency edges, 72,704 complement source rows, and 18 malformed inputs; the prior GATE283 independent U198 UNSAT refutation (3,666 nodes) and V198 SAT witness were rerun. U198 UNSAT and V198 SAT have exactly the same endpoint values $|U|=132$, $\nu=64$, $\rho=68$. On Y6 at radius two, matching saves 4 search nodes but raises counted source probes from 258 to 291 and makes 9 matching calls; its total-work advantage is not established. Offline complete logical XOR and fixed-mask proxy XOR are \emph{not} native FLMV work/index tape $d_{\rm phys}$. The existing GATE244 ordinary UP-dominance theorem remains intact. \paragraph{LSPV-3 GATE289 M22 FOURIER-PAIR-CERT (31 October 2026, 20:24 PDT; PROVED/EXACT restricted, external mathematical review pending; COMPUTATIONAL independent verification).}
For every valid duplicate-free proper Monotone $3$-SAT-$(2,2)$ original source, the number $V_F(x)$ of falsified original clauses has exact spin-Fourier expansion
\[
8V_F(x)=m+\sum_{i<j}c_{ij}z_i z_j+\sum_{i<j<k}d_{ijk}z_i z_j z_k,
\]
with $z_i=(-1)^{x_i}$, $c_{ij}$ the unsigned clause-pair multiplicity, and $d_{ijk}$ the signed triple multiplicity. Every linear coefficient vanishes because each variable has exactly two occurrences of each sign. Opposite-setting a shared variable pair yields conditional expected violations $(m-c_{ij})/8$. Since every valid $n=6$ source has $m=8$, the classical method of conditional expectations then constructs a complete checked SAT witness. Conversely for $n\ge9$, $m\ge12$ and $c_{ij}\le4$, no partial assignment on at most two variables meets the strict expectation-$<1$ certificate. More generally any seed of $r$ variables with expectation $<1$ requires $r>(m-8)/4=n/3-2$; at $n=198$ it needs at least 65 fixed variables. This is a barrier \emph{only for this certificate}, not arbitrary SAT algorithms or source-compression procedures.

Independent exhaustive verification checked all $75^2=5{,}625$ distinct valid six-variable signed source families and $360{,}000$ source-assignment pairs: all SAT, with $18$--$26$ models each. The source-checked controller used $1{,}350{,}000$ conditional/witness literal positions versus $509{,}716$ DPLL literal probes, before shared input validation. The $K_{3,3}$ control has 234 nonsatisfying quadratic minimizers and 18 satisfying ones. The U198 UNSAT modular certificate was independently replayed (3,666 nodes), V198 SAT was checked against 264 original clauses, and the original S/U modes, 69,674 pairs, 1,716 occurrence inversions, 4,736 Walsh coefficients and logical XOR controls passed. Physical indexed-TM $d_{\rm phys}$ remains unmeasured. The conditional-expectation method and Fourier SAT representation are \emph{known techniques}, with no novelty claimed from a repository phrase-search absence.

\paragraph{LSPV-4 MULTIEDGE-TRIANGLE-FPT315 (1 November 2026, 15:05 PST).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted authenticated multigraph triangle-certificate optimisation using the KNOWN polynomial simple-graph maximum edge-disjoint triangle algorithm; COMPUTATIONAL independent source controls; universal all-input ARC and P versus NP OPEN.}
On any valid duplicate-free proper D\"ocker monotone 3-SAT-(2,2) original and coherent source pin cube, its original-clause-ID binary residual multigraph has maximum incidence degree four. Keeping the lowest-ID edge per unordered endpoint pair leaves a simple degree-four graph and a set of $d$ extra source-labelled parallel edges. Every extra edge belongs to at most four source-ID triangles, hence at most $4d$ triangles touch any extra. Enumerate compatible subsets of those triangles and solve the remaining simple maximum-edge-disjoint-triangle packing by the polynomial-time result of McKay--Manlove, \emph{Discrete Applied Mathematics} 352 (2024), 20--32. The source-labelled optimum is thereby computable in $2^{4d}\operatorname{poly}(N)$ total work and polynomial writable space, so $d=O(\log N)$ permits polynomial certificate acquisition, with all discovery and query costs charged. The finite checker uses exhaustive simple packing and is \emph{not} a model-matched native FLMV solver.

A valid F9 same-original cube $x_1=1,x_4=0,x_5=1,x_8=0$ produces distinct opposite-signed source edges $5,11$ between $x_7,x_9$. One-representative projection gives maximum triangle packing $1$, but certified source-edge-disjoint triangles $(3,7,11)$ and $(4,5,10)$ yield optimum $2$ and $\delta^*=-1$; exact original-clause enumeration confirms UNSAT. \paragraph{LSPV-4 ARC-FAR-BLANK-GUARD274 (31 October 2026, 06:36 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted, external mathematical review pending;}
\textbf{COMPUTATIONAL} finite same-source original-clause and guest trace controls;
\textbf{KNOWN THEOREM} actual FLMV; \textbf{OPEN} universal ARC.
The previously verified BOUNDED-GUEST-INPUT273 host simulation required both
the guest input-index \emph{head extent} $h=O(\log M)$ and an extra
$O(M)$ guest input-head \emph{coordinate} restriction. The latter
restriction is unnecessary for one faithfully simulated guest run on
a genuine $M$-character ordinary-SAT child held on a \emph{counted}
indexed host work tape. With guest time $T=T_A(M)$ and guest work/index
space $S_A(M)$, a charged binary virtual input coordinate,
guest-index-tape erasure with preserved index-head position, an exact
blank guard, and all child-buffer index writes give
\[
 T_{\rm host}=O\bigl(M+T[h+\log(M+T+2)+1]\bigr),\qquad
 S_{\rm host}=O\bigl(M+S_A(M)+h+\log(M+T+2)\bigr).
\]
Thus $h=O(\log M)$ and polynomial $T$ suffice for
$O(M+T\log M)$ time and $O(M+S_A+\log M)$ space,
even when the guest reads a blank at address $\Omega(M^2)$.
This does \emph{not} handle unrestricted polynomial-time guests:
a correctness-preserving guest may walk its input-index head
$\Omega(M)$ cells, as already demonstrated by BOUNDED273.

reconciles and strengthens the precise bounded-index contract rather
than asserting a new unrestricted capability.

variables in $C_i$, including internal binary clauses, and define
$r_i=\operatorname{rank}(\pi_{P_i}L_i)$ and
$e_i=\max(r_i-1,0)$. Partition the graph of binary interactions between
affine components into connected clusters $D_j$ and put
$K_j=\sum_{i\in D_j}e_i$. A uniform source-authenticated solver
branches on $r_i-1$ exposed coordinates in each component and leaves
at most one Boolean quotient bit per component. Every residual $B$
is then 2CNF, so paid SCC decisions and witness reconstruction give
$\operatorname{poly}(N)(1+\sum_j 2^{K_j})$ time and polynomial
peak workspace. This strictly improves the \emph{bound for this
explicit algorithm} over branching on full affine component nullity,
and complements the LSPV-3 projected-rank/treewidth table bounds.
A dense complete-interaction family with $q$ components and
$h=q^2$ private pairs per component has old excess $q^3$,
exposed excess zero, and a directly materialized ordinary 2CNF child
of physical length $O(N^{2/3}\operatorname{polylog}N)
\le N^{3/4}$ eventually, with a closed restricted-base decision.
The same family is not strict signed exact-$(2,2)$ 3CNF, and the
construction does not contract arbitrary SAT. An internal-clause
counterexample shows that ignoring binary constraints inside affine
components is unsound. Conservatively, for
$R=1+\sum_j2^{K_j}$, fixed two-tape sequential-input
construction time is $O(RN^6)$ with $O(N^2)$ workspace;
one-tape simulation gives $O(RN^8)$ time and $O(N^2)$
source-inclusive footprint, with no exact fixed-UTM exponent claimed.
The independent Python audit passed 6,659 assertions; the
original connected-interface audit reproduced byte-for-byte.
Neither $P=NP$ nor $P\ne NP$ follows. LSPV-1/LSPV-5
handoff was published and verified.
\path{research/agents/lspv-4/2026-10-29_0607_LSPV-4_PROJECTED_EXCESS_SCC222.tex}.

\textbf{FOUR-PIN-ONLINE-CONTEXT226 (PROVED/EXACT restricted online
information theorem; independently refereed).}
For connected proper 3CNFs $F_{t,s}$, four pinned variables define queries
$Q_i$ with $\operatorname{SAT}(F_{t,s}\land Q_i)=s_i$.  A deterministic
source-free state answering a later adversarial $Q_i$ therefore needs at least
$t$ bits on some source.  If the source remains readable, a scan uses only
logarithmic auxiliary space; writable-cell consequences require fixed heads,
finite alphabet and polynomial time.  All unaugmented sources are SAT, so this
is not a decision-only contraction or runtime lower bound.

\subsection{LSPV-4 HYBRID-BAD-MESSAGE228: exact exceptional-union interfaces (October 29, 2026)}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT on an authenticated restricted module-tree grammar, independent referee pending; unrestricted SAT OPEN.}
Extending LSPV-1 ARC229's exact bijunctive-message closure, at each node $t$ retain non-bijunctive child relations as full explicit separator tables, absorb each exactly certified 2CNF-definable child message into the local binary clauses, and enumerate only
\[
 E_t=S_t\cup\bigcup_{\text{non-bijunctive child }u}S_u,\qquad h_t=|E_t|,
\]
where $S_t$ is the \emph{parent-edge separator}, not the complete full shared-variable interface.
For polynomially authenticated running-intersection trees with once-only source constraint ownership and local affine coefficient rank $e_t$, deterministic exact bottom-up SAT/UNSAT decision and SAT witness reconstruction use conservatively
\[
 D(N)+\operatorname{poly}(N)\sum_t\left[
 2^{h_t}(N_t+1)^{O(e_t+1)}+2^{|S_t|}\operatorname{poly}(|S_t|+1)
 \right]
\]
indexed-RAM bit time, with all failed local routes and full tables charged. Uniformly fixed $e_t$, logarithmic $h_t$ and $|S_t|$, polynomial decomposition discovery and polynomial node count imply polynomial total computation on this \emph{restricted} verified class even when full interfaces are linear. A rank-one star of $q$ equality leaves and $h$ odd-parity leaves has full centre interface $2q+3h$ but exceptional union $3h$; its SAT value is the centre target parity $\beta=h\bmod2$. A two-odd-parity-child overlap has sum of separator sizes six but exceptional union three. When $h$ grows, this particular controller has a potentially exponential branch-mass bound; no algorithm-independent hardness follows. The original fixed-$e$ local algorithm is \textbf{KNOWN THEOREM} (Arvind--Guruswami IPEC 2021); no new $e=2$ claim is made. \textbf{COMPUTATIONAL}: 259 randomized small-tree differential controls, 24 SAT/UNSAT stars, four source-validation failures correctly rejected, 278 exhaustive arity-at-most-three relation recognitions, and overlap controls passed. The local reproducibility bundle contains the extended Python source and raw results; a compact independent JavaScript check and raw results are on GitHub. The four-pin online lower bound remains source-free and contextual, not decision-only SAT hardness. No ARC/FLMV forbidden-region transition or strict exact-$(2,2)$ universal decomposition coverage has been proved.
Report: \texttt{research/agents/lspv-4/2026-10-29\_1336\_LSPV-4\_HYBRID\_BAD\_MESSAGE228.tex}.

\paragraph{LSPV-4 SPARSE-EXTREME-SLACK244 (30 October 2026, 01:40 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted, independent referee pending; COMPUTATIONAL finite checks; general complexity OPEN.}
For a proper strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ 3CNF, exactly two same-polarity and four opposite-polarity source-occurrence pair events arise per original variable. Therefore only at most $6n$ original clause pairs have a nondefault local $SS,SU,US,UU$ extremal compatibility mode. A sorted sparse source-index table encodes the complete four-mode relation in $O(n\log m)$ bits and can be compiled in $O(N+n\log n)$ indexed word-RAM operations, in contrast to an \emph{optional} $4\binom m2$-bit explicit dense matrix. Actual connected strict22 $H_{200}$ has $n=1200,m=1600$, exactly 5200 nondefault pairs; dense-mode bitpacked payload 5,116,800 bits versus a conservative sparse record payload 124,800 bits. These are implementation-specific representation costs, not all-algorithm SAT resource lower bounds.

For coherent original-variable pinning $\rho$ fixing $k$ coordinates, at a nonconflicting original-source unit-propagation fixed point define $Z$ uncovered original clauses, $H_2,H_3$ original clauses with respectively exactly two and three pinned-TRUE occurrences, $w$ uncovered residual ternary clauses, and $e$ free occurrence count in already-satisfied clauses. The exact \emph{signed-occurrence slack} $d=m/2-H_2-H_3$ satisfies $\boxed{2d=w+e}$. Selecting one free variable per uncovered ternary clause yields a certified strong 2SAT backdoor of size $h\le w\le 2d$, with polynomial acquisition and charged $2^h$ leaf search, no universal polynomial bound. On the previously verified connected SAT family $H_r$, pinning the two original variables $x_{j,5}=x_{j,6}=0$ in every block gives a source-UP-saturated UNSAT partial cube with $d=4r$, $w=0$, $e=8r$. Nevertheless a non-tautological original-parent resolution DAG with at most five steps proves the width-at-most-four source clause
$R_j=x_{j,5}\lor x_{j,6}\lor x_{j-1,5}\lor x_{j-1,6}$; its falsification excludes this entire original-variable cube. Thus linear signed-occurrence slack does not force large proof or search work, even on connected strict22 SAT sources. This is an explicit restricted falsification of any such intrinsic-cost proposal.

\paragraph{LSPV-4 COMPLEMENT-GRAY248 (30 October 2026, 04:36 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted explicit-enumeration resource theorem,
independent mathematical referee pending; COMPUTATIONAL full 14-source
audit; P versus NP OPEN.}
For every original proper ternary clause $C_j$ and signed occurrence
$x_{i,j}$, the independently audited local all-literals-TRUE target
$S_j$ and all-literals-FALSE target $U_j$ invert one another; the
four original source-pair compatibility modes $SS,SU,US,UU$ retain
all shared variable identities.  The raw original-source data include
coherent $0^n,1^n$, intermediate one/multiple-variable Gray flips,
per-clause $t_j=0,1,2,3$, complementary four-bucket counts,
source-parent resolution proofs and forbidden partial cubes.
An original proper strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ 3CNF with $n$
variables has exactly $2^{n-1}$ complete assignment/complement orbits.
Fixing $x_n=0$ and using the standard reflected $(n-1)$-bit Gray
sequence visits one representative from each orbit with precisely
$2^{n-1}-1$ coherent global flips, updating exactly four original
clause truth counters per step.  The full explicit UNSAT traversal
therefore has exactly $4(2^{n-1}-1)$ affected counter writes, with
$O(N+2^{n-1})$ indexed word-RAM selected work and $O(N+n+m)$
untraced words.  Among explicit one-bit paths visiting all orbits
and explicitly maintaining the per-clause counter array, this number
of flips and writes is minimal; it is \emph{not} a lower bound on
arbitrary SAT solvers, which may reason symbolically or prune.
The complete $m$-counter output vector on each representative
costs $\Omega(m2^{n-1})$ output fields even when the maintained
working state is small.  On authenticated strict22 W1 UNSAT
($n=15,m=20$), the quotient traversal visits 16,384 orbits,
uses 16,383 variable flips and 65,532 source-counter updates,
versus 131,068 counter updates on the full unpaired Gray path;
materializing all quotient vectors costs 327,680 fields.
Fourteen coherent source-controlled cases passed 5,988 original
pair-mode checks, 536 triple-mode checks, 336,688
assignment/complement validations and 92 independently replayed
UNSAT UP--DPLL contradiction leaves.  The same-source W1 baseline
DPLL used 151 nodes/15,431 selected solver events, while a fixed
eight-resolvent prepass plus DPLL used 81 nodes/15,170
\emph{fully charged} selected events (including source-mode
construction and resolvent acquisition); independent proof replay
added 11,283 and 8,494 events, respectively.  On H1 SAT the
same prepass reduced nodes 7 to 5 but worsened charged work
288 to 1,400; no uniform speedup is established.  Python
\texttt{tracemalloc} on W1 showed baseline 60,536 allocated peak
bytes, minimal quotient 13,916, quotient retaining the dense
source audit 151,266 and resolution retaining it 214,237.
These are Python allocation snapshots, not Turing-machine space
bounds.  This result complements earlier BUCKET-FLIP247 and
SPARSE-EXTREME-SLACK244 without claiming Gray codes or source
resolution as novel SAT methods.

The proposed conditional fixed point $(6/5,1/2)$ is inside this forbidden
region, but no all-input transformer realizing it is known.

\textbf{PROVED/EXACT, restricted physical-cofactor firewall (independent review
pending).} For a proper strict signed exact-$(2+,2-)$ 3CNF with $n$ variables,
$m=4n/3$ original clauses and a declared fixed-slot record of
$B=\Theta(\log n)$ bits, pinning $t$ globally coherent variables
can delete at most $2t$ source clauses.  Thus an ordinary plain-cofactor
child has $N_\rho\ge N-2tB$ bits and obtaining $N_\rho\le N^\lambda$ for
fixed $\lambda<1$ by this mechanism requires
$t\ge m/2-O(N^\lambda/\log N)=\Omega(n)$.
This is a source-specific \emph{compiler} obstruction, not an arbitrary
SAT time or space lower bound.  The earlier short virtual child descriptor
still describes a full-scale ordinary SAT input unless its physical
encoded length actually shrinks.

children of length $N^\lambda$, $N^\alpha$ charged source/discovery work,

\emph{multiplicative} per-guest-step accessor slowdown, and retained-cache
space exponent $\rho$, the justified abstract upper profile is
$K'\le\max\{\alpha,\gamma+\delta,\gamma+\varepsilon+\lambda K\}$ and

of work and live tapes satisfy the same accounting.  For

retention mask with $m$ slots, block length $h$ and

$S_{\rm idx}=\lceil m/h\rceil w$ stored bits and, in the worst case,
$Q\ge h-1$ read-only mask-bit probes to answer one exact
$\operatorname{select}$ query. Hence
$S_{\rm idx}(Q+1)\ge mw$. With source size
$N=\Theta(m\log m)$, this restricted architecture cannot satisfy
both $S_{\rm idx}=O(N^{s+o(1)})$ and
$Q=O(N^{\varepsilon+o(1)})$ when $s+\varepsilon<1$.
The current hypothetical FLMV/ARC budget $s=1/2$,
$\varepsilon<1/400$ fails \emph{for this index alone};
no bound on all succinct rank/select indexes or SAT algorithms follows.

falsifies such an overgeneralization.

A deterministic one-pass, label-only decoder of $q$ exact child SAT/UNSAT outcomes in a \emph{fixed} prescribed order requires at least
$\lceil\log_2 w_D(k)\rceil$ counted mutable bits at cut $k$, where
$w_D(k)$ is the number of different residual functions induced by the $k$-bit child-label prefixes.
This is the established ordered-BDD residual-function theorem, not new general SAT hardness.
Blocked equality on $q=2h$ independently variable labels has $w_D(h)=2^h$ and demands $h$ bits;
paired equality permits a two-bit stream, while AND/OR/XOR need one bit.

cannot fit the actual simultaneous FLMV work/index space exponent
$d_*(241/200)=11642479/23232400\approx0.501131$, assuming that restricted interface.

are COMPUTATIONAL only and not native FLMV timings.

L'\le\max\{1/2+\eta,\,1/2+\xi,\,(1/2+\xi)L\}.

Writing $\zeta=\max\{\eta,\xi\}$, this \emph{recurrence certificate}

\[

$\xi_*\approx0.0019122778182$ with

$\xi_*=1/2-(3/5)/c_*$. Thus $N^{0.502}$ physical children
\emph{fail this particular recurrence certificate}, even with other
perturbations zero, while $N^{0.501}$ passes. This is not a theorem
against all possible compilers. Full source re-read per

\paragraph{LSPV-4 ARC-COVER-GATE-SCOPE262 (30 October 2026, 20:36 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted many-one cover-gate reduction, independent referee pending.}
For any proper 3CNF $H=\bigwedge_j(a_j\vee b_j\vee c_j)$, set
$F_H=\bigwedge_j[(y\vee a_j\vee z_j)\wedge(\neg z_j\vee b_j\vee c_j)]$.
Every $F_H$ is SAT by $y=1,z_j=0$, while
$F_H\models y$ if and only if $H$ is UNSAT. Hence even a
single-cube \emph{source-relative semantic cover} test is coNP-complete
on parents promised SAT. This is the known backbone/entailment
phenomenon applied to the LSPV-5 residual-cover gate, not an
unrestricted SAT lower bound. Exact SAT child answers cannot certify an
UNSAT parent without a source-relative cover proof, a complete
syntactic partition, or an exact uncovered-region fallback; witness
termination on the SAT side does not require cover.

\subsection*{REFEREE261 synthesis: exact source-faithful wrapper depth firewall}
\textbf{Status: \PROVED{} forward and inverse raw-cofactor bounds;
\COMPUTATIONAL{} same-source controls; \OPEN{} semantic/noninjective
contraction, arbitrary \(A\mapsto\Phi(A)\), numerical FLMV transport, and
P versus NP.}

For a connected valid source and coherent \(b=k_0+k_1\)-pin nonterminal raw
cofactor, every erased free identity consumes both positive and both negative
source occurrences.  Deleted positive clauses charge at most \(4k_1\) free
occurrences and deleted negative clauses at most \(4k_0\), so
\(e\le2\min(k_0,k_1)\) and \(r\ge n-2b\).  Removing the \(b\)
degree-four pinned variable vertices creates at most \(3b\) extra components;
the at most \(2b\) satisfied clauses then have residual degree at most two
and create at most \(2b\) more.  Therefore
\[
 c\le1+5b,\qquad
 L\ge\left\lceil\frac{n-2b}{1+5b}\right\rceil .
\]
Equivalently, all components of size at most \(M\) require
\[
 b\ge\left\lceil\frac{n-M}{2+5M}\right\rceil.
\]
This gives \(\Omega(n^{1-\lambda})\) depth at
\(M=\lfloor n^\lambda\rfloor\) only for the declared source-faithful raw
wrapper.  It does not lower-bound semantic re-encoders, cached DAGs, pruned
proofs, arbitrary guests, or arbitrary SAT machines.

The independent verifier recomputed 104,229 assertions.  It exhausted all 729
Y6 ternary partial assignments and checked 480 identical source-indexed
restrictions at depths 1--12 on U198 UNSAT and V198 SAT.  U remained UNSAT;
V remained SAT by its complete witness.  Original S/U targets and inversions,
all pair modes, endpoints, flips, changed clause IDs, and binary/Gray logical
XOR remain adversarial controls.  Actual \(d_{\rm phys}\) was not measured
and XOR tracing was offline.

LSPV-3's boundary-signature cache and LSPV-2's pivot projection remain sound
restricted tools, but neither is the all-input canonical power-short compiler:
U/V have unbounded paired defect for the former, while the latter emits a
noncanonical representation-long child.  The affine theorem remains restricted
to source-independent affine MCSP maps.  NP-completeness alone does not

\subsection*{REFEREE260 synthesis: connected raw restriction/component firewall}
\textbf{Status: \PROVED{} structural characterization and one-pivot component
bound; \COMPUTATIONAL{} controls; \OPEN{} semantic/noninjective contraction,
numerical FLMV transport, and P versus NP.}

For every valid target \(F\) and coherent partial assignment \(p\), a nonempty
raw cofactor \(F|p\) is target-valid up to relabeling iff it is an unchanged
union of source incidence components left wholly untouched by \(p\), with every
outside clause satisfied.  Exact two-per-polarity counts force all four source
occurrences of any surviving variable to remain; this propagates across its
entire source component.  Thus connected sources have no nonempty canonical raw
child after a nonempty assignment.

For a single pivot on a connected \(n\)-variable source, every other source
identity survives.  Every residual component contains a co-variable from one
of the pivot's four source clauses, hence one of at most eight neighbors.
Therefore there are at most eight residual components and the largest has at
least \(\lceil(n-1)/8\rceil\) variables.  For fixed \(\lambda<1\) this exceeds
\(n^\lambda\) for sufficiently large \(n\).  SAT component recursion must solve
all pieces; UNSAT early stop must discover a refuted piece and cannot assume a
free best-policy oracle.

Independent replay passed 110,602 checks.  All 396 U198 and 396 V198 one-pivot
residuals retained 197 identities, stayed connected in the tested sources, and
were noncanonical; all 12 Y6 branches behaved likewise.  Exhaustive Y6 cubes
gave one nonempty canonical state (the empty assignment), 500 noncanonical

\subsection*{REFEREE259 synthesis: exact component-amortization threshold}
\textbf{Status: \PROVED{} for the certificate-carrying composition and exact
additive threshold; \OPEN{} for all-input power shrink, arbitrary
\(A\mapsto\Phi(A)\), FLMV transport, and P versus NP.}

For every valid canonical disjoint union \(F=G\mathbin{\dot\cup}P\), pivot
\(x\in\operatorname{var}(G)\), branch \(b\), and checked SAT witness for each
component of \(P\),
\[
 \operatorname{SAT}(F|_{x=b})\iff
 \operatorname{SAT}(G|_{x=b})\iff
 \operatorname{SAT}(R(G,x=b)).
\]
Writing \(h=|\operatorname{var}(P)|\), exact occurrence counting gives
\[
 |P|=4h/3,\qquad
 (n',m')=(n-h+201,m-4h/3+268).
\]
Both counts shrink iff \(h>201\); divisibility forces the minimum \(h=204\).
The declared encoding controls cross at the same point:
U198/V198 plus 33 disjoint Y6 components grow from 14,820 to 14,932 bits,
whereas plus 34 shrink from 15,044 to 14,932 bits.  Both SAT and UNSAT labels
were checked from the same constructions.  The independent verifier replayed
575,026 checks.

For fixed \(\lambda<1\), however,
\[
 n-h+201\le n^\lambda
 \iff h\ge n+201-n^\lambda.
\]
Thus the retained answer-bearing core already must have at most
\(n^\lambda-201\) variables.  Connected inputs have \(h=0\) and still grow.
On UNSAT sources an admissible policy must retain an UNSAT component while
supplying checked SAT witnesses for every discarded component.  Acquisition,
selection, switching, source/index access, certificate/output streams, guest
delay/failures, and simultaneous peak space remain charged.  No free
best-policy oracle or nonuniform advice is admitted.

The signed S/U, endpoint, pair-compatibility, and binary/Gray XOR controls are
adversarial diagnostics only.  Actual \(d_{\rm phys}\) was not measured;
DELAY and read-only rereads perform work with zero data-bit changes.
LSPV-4 SURVIVOR-FRONTIER292 adds the compatible restricted theorem
\(e(p)\le2\min(k_0,k_1)\): source-identity-preserving one-pivot children are
not shorter.  It does not rule out semantic/noninjective compression.

The affine small-bias theorem remains only a restricted semantic/MCSP no-go.
NP-completeness alone does not transport the numerical FLMV box.  The next
load-bearing target is a connected-instance semantic contraction or a smaller
critical gadget; easy disconnected padding is now classified as an exact
amortizer, not an ARC proof.

\paragraph{XOR-ACTIVITY-IDENTITY-REFEREE251 (31 October 2026, 15:48 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT fixed-representation activity identity; COMPUTATIONAL
same-target controls; XOR as an independent hardness resource
FALSIFIED/RETIRED; universal ARC and P versus NP OPEN.}
For the aligned state
\[
 S_e(F,a)=a\ \Vert\ \bigl(e(t_j(a)),\mathbf1[t_j(a)>0]\bigr)_{j=1}^{m},
\]
one flip of variable \(x_i\) in any CNF without repeated variables inside a
clause has
\[
 d_{\rm logic}^{\rm Gray}=1+d_i+B_i,\qquad
 d_{\rm logic}^{\rm bin}=1+d_i+B_i+H_i,
\]
where \(d_i\) is source occurrence degree, \(B_i\) counts incident
\(0\leftrightarrow1\) true-count transitions, and \(H_i\) counts
\(1\leftrightarrow2\) transitions.  Gray adjacent count codewords differ in
one bit; binary uses two bits only on the middle edge.  Every valid D\"ocker
target has \(d_i=4\), giving \(5+B_i\) and \(5+B_i+H_i\), both between five
and nine.  Summing proves the arbitrary, possibly backtracking trace identities
\[
 \sum_t d_{{\rm logic},t}^{\rm Gray}=5T+\sum_t B_t,\qquad
 \sum_t d_{{\rm logic},t}^{\rm bin}=5T+\sum_t(B_t+H_t).
\]
Thus the declared logical XOR is a local transition ledger, independent of the
SAT/UNSAT label.

Exact controls covered all 384 single flips of all 64 \(Y_6\) assignments,
13,068 \(U_{198}\) flips and 13,266 \(V_{198}\) flips, for 239,310 target
identity assertions.  A common 1,000-flip trace gave UNSAT/SAT Gray totals
6008/6009 and binary totals 7930/7928.  The prior 59,504-node same-source UNSAT
certificate and complete SAT witness were replayed; capped UP-DPLL left both

\paragraph{XOR-ORDER-SCOPE-REFEREE250 (31 October 2026, 14:48 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT comparable-endpoint logical XOR formula; COMPUTATIONAL
same-target controls; unrestricted order/runtime inference FALSIFIED/RETIRED;
universal ARC and P versus NP OPEN.}
For any clausewise-monotone CNF with distinct variables within each clause,
fix the aligned logical state
\[
 S(a)=a\ \Vert\ \big\Vert_j(e(t_j(a)),[t_j(a)>0]).
\]
If \(a\le b\) or \(a\ge b\) coordinatewise, every path that flips each
differing variable exactly once toward \(b\) has cumulative adjacent Hamming
distance
\[
 d_H(a,b)+\sum_j\sum_{r=\min(t_j(a),t_j(b))}^{\max(t_j(a),t_j(b))-1}
 \bigl(d_H(e(r),e(r+1))+\mathbf1_{\{r=0\}}\bigr).
\]
Each clause count is monotone and traverses each intervening integer exactly
once, proving order independence.  Full \(0^n\)-to-\(1^n\) sweeps therefore
give binary cumulative/endpoint totals \(n+5m,n+3m\) and Gray totals
\(n+4m,n+2m\).

The hypothesis is sharp.  For one clause \((x_1\vee x_2\vee x_3)\), binary
start/end \(001\to110\) gives cumulative totals \(7\) and \(9\) under two
orders; Gray \(001\to010\) gives \(4\) and \(6\).  A restored-bit detour with
the same \(000\to110\) endpoints doubles the binary direct total from \(6\)
to \(12\) (Gray \(5\) to \(11\)).  All \(720\) full \(Y_6\) sweep orders have
logical totals binary \(46\), Gray \(38\), while one declared eager
single-tape realization ranges over \(295\)--\(319\) and \(287\)--\(311\)
native steps.  Thus logical XOR does not determine physical time.

Exact controls include 10,592 comparable-endpoint paths and 63,552 assertions
on \(Y_6\), full witness replay for SAT \(V_{198}\), the empty module-boundary
certificate for UNSAT \(U_{198}\), 34,716 signed S/U clause-pair tests, five
malformed-input rejections, and independent whole-run index-recharge checks.
A fresh capped solver run returned \(V_{198}\) SAT and honestly left
\(U_{198}\) unresolved; no timeout was treated as UNSAT.  Discovery, source
and index access, switching, failed trials, children, output, checking and

\paragraph{ACQUISITION-QUERY-EXPONENT-REFEREE243 (31 October 2026, 07:48 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT restricted delay-wrapper theorem and bent controls;
universal ARC and P versus NP OPEN.}
Suppose a residual-SAT controller must complete
\(N^{\delta+o(1)}\) sequential acquisition queries, each an ordinary-SAT
instance of length \(N^{c+o(1)}\), before any authenticated terminal or child
is available.  For the arbitrary correct delayed guest \(A_D\), each query
costs at least its input length to the power \(D\), so the realized acquisition
exponent is at least \(\delta+cD\).  Consequently no all-guest hereditary
bound
\[
 K'\leq\max\{\alpha,\gamma+\lambda K\}
\]
can justify that compulsory implementation when \(c>\lambda\); choosing large
\(D\) violates it.  When \(c=\lambda\), this test requires
\(\delta\leq\gamma\), but does not prove sufficiency.  Discovery, reduction,
query construction, switching, failed trials, input/output access, guest delay,
verification, and source/tape/query/child/retained space remain charged.

The same-source audit of the guarded graph family independently confirms a
minimum strong Krom backdoor of \(\tau(G)+1\) for both its SAT positive-guard
and UNSAT eight-guard variants.  Its labels are directly recognizable, so
computing an optimum backdoor is not forced.  For one explicit sorting-network
vertex-cover acquisition encoding, sparse cycles give query length
\(N^{1/2+o(1)}\) and \(N^{1/2+o(1)}\) reconstruction calls, while dense complete
graphs give query length \(N^{2/3+o(1)}\) and \(N^{1/3+o(1)}\) calls.  Thus the
dense encoding has \(c=2/3>\lambda=1/2\) and fails the arbitrary-delay test if
made compulsory.  This is a representation-specific falsifier, not a lower
bound for every policy selector.

For every \(r\geq d\geq2\), the function
\[
 f_{r,d}(x,y)=x\cdot y\oplus\prod_{i=1}^{d}y_i
\]
is bent of algebraic degree \(d\).  Uniform sampling from \(f_{r,d}^{-1}(0)\)
has every nonzero linear bias exactly \(1/(2^r+1)\), while \(f_{r,d}\) itself
has distinguishing gap \((1-2^{-r})/2\).  This exact family shows that linear
small bias alone controls no nonlinear degree.  It neither identifies the
CHMY easy-source ensemble nor supplies a SAT/MCSP runtime transformation.
The affine theorem remains restricted semantic evidence only.

The independent verifier imports no producer code, checked 134,614 units and
rejected three corruptions.  The retained original-clause S/U controls checked

\paragraph{ARC-TRANSACTION-CAP-REFEREE242 (31 October 2026, 06:48 PDT).}
\textbf{PROVED/EXACT serial transaction ledger; COMPUTATIONAL controls;

For one deterministic host running source-authenticated certified policies
serially, let \(P\) be persistent writable controller state and let
\(t_i,r_i,v_i\) and \(b_i,c_i\) be, respectively, policy, reset and
verification time and live policy/certificate space for realized trial \(i\).
